title: Forecasting and Detection of Paroxysmal Atrial Fibrillation from Electrocardiograms Using Transparent Deep Learning Models
Reply to the letter to the editor regarding “Association between atherosclerosis and atrial fibrillation progression in patients with paroxysmal atrial fibrillation: Data from the RACE V study”
Management of Post-heart Transplant Atrial Fibrillation
summary: AF is the most common atrial arrhythmia encountered after orthotopic heart transplantation, with distinct pathophysiology and clinical implications. While early postoperative AF is typically transient, late-onset AF is increasingly recognised as a marker of graft dysfunction, rejection or vasculopathy. Risk factors include advanced recipient age, prolonged ischaemic time and immunosuppressive therapy. The denervated status of the transplanted heart alters typical electrophysiology, complicating diagnosis and management. Management requires individualised strategies balancing rate versus rhythm control, careful drug interaction monitoring and thromboembolic risk assessment. Emerging evidence supports catheter ablation in select cases, although data remain limited. Immunosuppressants, particularly calcineurin inhibitors and azathioprine, may increase AF susceptibility. Given the lack of transplant-specific AF guidelines, a multidisciplinary approach is essential. Improved understanding of AF in orthotopic heart transplantation is critical to optimising graft longevity and patient survival. Future studies are needed to guide evidence-based management and surveillance.

title: Quantitative pericardial calcification score as an imaging marker for atrial fibrillation in constrictive pericarditis
summary: Constrictive pericarditis (CP) is frequently complicated by atrial fibrillation (AF), which worsens prognosis. Prior studies only qualitatively described pericardial calcification in relation to AF, lacking quantitative thresholds. This study aimed to quantify pericardial calcification via CT and investigate its association with AF in CP. We retrospectively analyzed 221 tuberculous CP patients, classified into an AF group ( n = 42) and a non-AF group ( n = 179). Pericardial calcification was quantified using the Agatston score. An internally derived exploratory cutoff for discriminating AF was determined via ROC analysis. A multivariable model incorporating the log-transformed calcification score and age was constructed, with internal validation performed using 500 bootstrap resamples. Firth’s penalized regression was used as a sensitivity analysis. Compared with the non-AF group, patients in the AF group were older, exhibited longer disease duration and significantly higher calcification scores (14,777.05 [30,281.80] vs.0.00 [0.00], P < 0.001). The internally derived exploratory cutoff for the log-transformed calcification score was 5.867 (raw score: 352.2), yielding a univariate AUC of 0.872. Multivariable analysis confirmed that both the log-transformed calcification score (OR 1.537, bootstrap 95% CI: 1.400–1.847) and age (OR 1.040, bootstrap 95% CI: 1.014–1.079) were independently associated with AF. The composite model achieved an AUC of 0.903. Internal bootstrap validation yielded an optimism-corrected AUC of 0.898 and a calibration slope of 0.969, indicating robust performance and favorable calibration. Sensitivity analysis using Firth’s regression yielded consistent estimates (calcification OR 1.516; age OR 1.038), confirming robustness. Pericardial calcification and age are independent factors associated with AF in CP. A log-transformed calcification score of 5.867 (equivalent to a raw score of 352.2) was identified as an internally derived exploratory cutoff for AF.

title: U-shaped association of serum potassium with all-cause mortality in patients with atrial fibrillation and chronic kidney disease: a retrospective cohort study
summary: Given the frequent coexistence and bidirectional relationship of atrial fibrillation (AF) and chronic kidney disease (CKD), and the known cardiovascular risks of potassium abnormalities, the impact of serum potassium on mortality in this high-risk population was unclear. This retrospective cohort study investigated the association between serum potassium levels and all-cause mortality in 1703 patients diagnosed with AF and CKD in the First Affiliated Hospital of Shantou University Medical College between August 2018 and December 2023. Multivariate Cox proportional hazards models, restricted cubic spline (RCS), inflection point analysis, and subgroup analyses were used to assess mortality risk across potassium categories: <3.60, 3.60–3.80, 3.80-4.00, 4.00-4.20, 4.20–4.40 (reference: 4.40–4.60), 4.60–4.80, and > 4.80 mmol/L. With the nadir of risk at 4.55 mmol/L via RCS analysis, the results revealed a significant U-shaped association between serum potassium levels and all-cause mortality. Compared to the reference group (4.40–4.60 mmol/L), patients with the lowest potassium levels (< 3.60 mmol/L) had a significantly increased risk of all-cause mortality (HR = 1.55, 95% CI: 1.02–2.35). Similarly, patients with the highest potassium levels (> 4.80 mmol/L) also showed a significantly elevated risk (HR = 1.73; 95% CI, 1.12–2.66). No statistically significant increased mortality risk was observed for other potassium categories. The study concludes that both hypokalemia (< 3.60 mmol/L) and hyperkalemia (> 4.80 mmol/L) are independently associated with an increased risk of all-cause death in AF patients with CKD, demonstrating a U-shaped relationship. However, these results are hypothesis-generating and require prospective validation before clinical implementation. What was known: The prevalenceof AF in CKD is about two- to three-fold higher than that reported in the general population. Some guidelines currentlyrecommend a strict serum potassium management target in AF or CKD patients, which may help avoid adverse events. However, notreatment recommendations were provided for potassium management in AF patients with CKD. This study adds: In addition to hypokalemia and hyperkalemia, low-normal (< 3.60 mmol/L) and high-normal range potassium levels (> 4.80 mmol/L) wereassociated with increased mortality risk, which filled the evidence gap in AF patients with CKD. Potential impact: Among this high-risk population, management within a narrower serum potassium level may enhance the prognosis.

AI.tldr: 在1703例房颤合并慢性肾病患者中，血清钾与全因死亡呈U型关联，低钾（<3.60 mmol/L）和高钾（>4.80 mmol/L）均独立增加死亡风险。

AI.method: 回顾性队列研究，纳入2018年8月至2023年12月汕头大学医学院第一附属医院诊断房颤合并慢性肾病的1703例患者。采用多因素Cox比例风险模型、限制性立方样条、拐点分析和亚组分析，评估不同血清钾水平（<3.60、3.60–3.80、3.80–4.00、4.00–4.20、4.20–4.40、4.40–4.60（参照）、4.60–4.80、>4.80 mmol/L）与全因死亡风险的关联。
AI.result: 限制性立方样条分析显示风险最低点为4.55 mmol/L，血清钾与全因死亡呈显著U型关联。与参照组（4.40–4.60 mmol/L）相比，最低钾组（<3.60 mmol/L）全因死亡风险显著增加（HR=1.55，95%CI：1.02–2.35），最高钾组（>4.80 mmol/L）风险亦显著升高（HR=1.73，95%CI：1.12–2.66）。其他钾水平组未见统计学显著的死亡风险增加。
AI.conclusion: 低钾（<3.60 mmol/L）和高钾（>4.80 mmol/L）均独立增加房颤合并慢性肾病患者的全因死亡风险，呈U型关系。该结果属假设生成性，临床实施前需前瞻性验证；提示对该高危人群可能需将血清钾管理在更窄范围内以改善预后。

summary_zh: 鉴于心房颤动（AF）与慢性肾脏病（CKD）常共存且存在双向关系，以及钾异常的已知心血管风险，血清钾对该高危人群死亡率的影响尚不明确。本回顾性队列研究调查了2018年8月至2023年12月期间在汕头大学医学院第一附属医院诊断为AF和CKD的1703例患者中血清钾水平与全因死亡率之间的关联。采用多变量Cox比例风险模型、限制性立方样条（RCS）、拐点分析和亚组分析评估不同钾类别（<3.60、3.60–3.80、3.80-4.00、4.00-4.20、4.20–4.40（参考：4.40–4.60）、4.60–4.80和>4.80 mmol/L）的死亡风险。通过RCS分析得出风险最低点为4.55 mmol/L，结果显示血清钾水平与全因死亡率之间存在显著的U型关联。与参考组（4.40–4.60 mmol/L）相比，钾水平最低（<3.60 mmol/L）的患者全因死亡风险显著增加（HR = 1.55，95% CI：1.02–2.35）。同样，钾水平最高（>4.80 mmol/L）的患者也显示出显著升高的风险（HR = 1.73；95% CI，1.12–2.66）。其他钾类别未观察到统计学上显著的死亡风险增加。研究结论认为，低钾血症（<3.60 mmol/L）和高钾血症（>4.80 mmol/L）均与AF合并CKD患者全因死亡风险增加独立相关，呈现U型关系。然而，这些结果是假设生成性的，在临床实施前需要前瞻性验证。已知：CKD中AF的患病率约为一般人群报告的2至3倍。目前一些指南建议对AF或CKD患者进行严格的血清钾管理目标，这可能有助于避免不良事件。然而，对于AF合并CKD患者的钾管理未提供治疗建议。本研究补充：除低钾血症和高钾血症外，正常低值（<3.60 mmol/L）和正常高值范围钾水平（>4.80 mmol/L）与死亡风险增加相关，填补了AF合并CKD患者的证据空白。潜在影响：在该高危人群中，将血清钾水平管理在较窄范围内可能改善预后。

title: Dual antithrombotic therapy with dabigatran and ticagrelor in patients with acute coronary syndrome and non-valvular atrial fibrillation undergoing percutaneous coronary intervention (ADONIS-PCI): protocol for a randomized controlled pilot trial.
summary:
INTRODUCTION: Patients with atrial fibrillation (AF) presenting with acute coronary syndrome (ACS) and undergoing percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) require protection against both cardioembolic and coronary thrombotic events, while facing a substantial bleeding risk. Oral anticoagulation (OAC) reduces the risk of stroke and systemic embolism but does not adequately address stent-related thrombotic risk. Conversely, dual antiplatelet therapy reduces recurrent coronary ischemic events and stent thrombosis but is insufficient for AF-related thromboembolism. Current antithrombotic strategies therefore rely on abbreviated triple antithrombotic therapy followed by dual antithrombotic therapy; however, the optimal P2Y12 inhibitor and dosing strategy in patients with AF and ACS treated with PCI remain uncertain.

MATERIAL AND METHODS: ADONIS-PCI is an investigator-initiated, prospective, multicenter, randomized, open-label, blindedendpoint, non-inferiority trial (NCT04695106; EUCT number: 2024-515056-20-00). Consecutive patients with nonvalvular AF hospitalized for ACS and successfully treated with PCI are randomized within 120 hours after PCI in a 1:1 ratio to receive either dual antithrombotic therapy with dabigatran (150 mg twice daily or 110 mg twice daily) plus ticagrelor (90 mg twice daily for 1 month, followed by 60 mg twice daily up to 12 months), or standard antithrombotic therapy according to contemporary guideline-based care, consisting of dabigatran (150 mg twice daily or 110 mg twice daily), clopidogrel (75 mg once daily), and aspirin (75 mg once daily), followed by dual therapy according to bleeding and ischemic risk. Study treatment is continued for 12 months. The primary endpoint is the first International Society on Thrombosis and Haemostasis (ISTH) major or clinically relevant non-major bleeding event in a time-to-event analysis. The main secondary endpoint is a composite of thromboembolic events (myocardial infarction, stroke, or systemic embolism), death, or unplanned revascularization (PCI or coronary artery bypass grafting) at 12 months. ADONIS-PCI will evaluate whether a dabigatran-based aspirin-free strategy using ticagrelor dose de-escalation can preserve ischemic protection while reducing the bleeding burden in patients with AF and ACS undergoing PCI.

CONCLUSIONS: ADONIS-PCI is among the first randomized evaluations of a reduced-dose long-term ticagrelor strategy combined with dabigatran in patients with AF and ACS undergoing PCI. The trial addresses an important evidence gap in the selection and dosing of P2Y12 inhibition when aspirin is discontinued early in this high-risk population.

AI.tldr: ADONIS-PCI试验旨在评估达比加群联合替格瑞洛（剂量递减）的无阿司匹林双联抗栓方案，在房颤合并ACS行PCI患者中能否在不增加缺血事件的前提下减少出血，目前仅为研究方案，尚无结果。
AI.motivation: 房颤合并急性冠脉综合征（ACS）并接受经皮冠状动脉介入治疗（PCI）的患者面临血栓栓塞与出血的双重风险。现有抗栓策略采用短期三联后转为双联，但最佳P2Y12抑制剂选择及剂量策略尚不明确，尤其缺乏无阿司匹林方案联合剂量递减替格瑞洛的证据。
AI.method: ADONIS-PCI为研究者发起的前瞻性、多中心、随机、开放标签、盲法终点、非劣效性试验（NCT04695106）。连续入组因ACS住院并成功行PCI的非瓣膜性房颤患者，PCI后120小时内1:1随机接受达比加群（150mg或110mg每日两次）联合替格瑞洛（90mg每日两次用1个月，后60mg每日两次至12个月）的双联抗栓治疗，或指南推荐的标准化抗栓治疗（达比加群+氯吡格雷75mg每日一次+阿司匹林75mg每日一次，后根据缺血出血风险转为双联）。治疗持续12个月。主要终点为首次ISTH大出血或临床相关非大出血事件（时间-事件分析）；主要次要终点为12个月血栓栓塞事件（心肌梗死、卒中或系统性栓塞）、死亡或非计划血运重建（PCI或CABG）的复合终点。
AI.result: 摘要未报告研究结果。
AI.conclusion: ADONIS-PCI是首批在房颤合并ACS行PCI患者中评估达比加群联合长期减量替格瑞洛无阿司匹林策略的随机试验之一，旨在填补该高危人群早期停用阿司匹林后P2Y12抑制剂选择与剂量方面的证据空白。若取得阳性结果，可能为优化抗栓方案、降低出血风险提供新选择，但需注意其 pilot 性质及开放标签设计的局限性。

summary_zh:
引言：因急性冠脉综合征（ACS）接受经皮冠状动脉介入治疗（PCI）的心房颤动（AF）患者需要同时预防心源性栓塞和冠状动脉血栓事件，同时面临显著的出血风险。口服抗凝（OAC）可降低卒中和系统性栓塞风险，但不足以应对支架相关血栓风险。相反，双联抗血小板治疗可减少复发性冠状动脉缺血事件和支架血栓形成，但对AF相关血栓栓塞不够充分。因此，当前抗血栓策略依赖于缩短的三联抗血栓治疗后接续双联抗血栓治疗；然而，在接受PCI治疗的AF和ACS患者中，最佳P2Y12抑制剂及给药策略仍不确定。

材料与方法：ADONIS-PCI是一项由研究者发起的前瞻性、多中心、随机、开放标签、盲终点、非劣效性试验（NCT04695106；EUCT编号：2024-515056-20-00）。因ACS住院并成功接受PCI的非瓣膜性AF连续患者，在PCI后120小时内按1:1比例随机接受达比加群（150 mg每日两次或110 mg每日两次）联合替格瑞洛（90 mg每日两次治疗1个月，随后60 mg每日两次至12个月）的双联抗血栓治疗，或根据当代指南指导的标准化抗血栓治疗，包括达比加群（150 mg每日两次或110 mg每日两次）、氯吡格雷（75 mg每日一次）和阿司匹林（75 mg每日一次），随后根据出血和缺血风险接受双联治疗。研究治疗持续12个月。主要终点是首次国际血栓与止血学会（ISTH）大出血或临床相关非大出血事件的时间-事件分析。主要次要终点是12个月时血栓栓塞事件（心肌梗死、卒中或系统性栓塞）、死亡或非计划血运重建（PCI或冠状动脉旁路移植术）的复合终点。ADONIS-PCI将评估基于达比加群的无阿司匹林策略联合替格瑞洛剂量递减能否在AF和ACS接受PCI的患者中保持缺血保护的同时减少出血负担。

结论：ADONIS-PCI是首批在AF和ACS接受PCI的患者中评估减剂量长期替格瑞洛策略联合达比加群的随机研究之一。该试验解决了在这一高危人群中早期停用阿司匹林时P2Y12抑制选择和给药方面的重要证据空白。

title: Scrimmage with 'Coronary Sinus Muscle Bridge': case series and clinical implications
summary: Objectives: The coronary sinus (CS) plays a key role in cardiac electrophysiology, including cardiac resynchronization therapy (CRT) and ablation of arrhythmias such as left-sided accessory pathways, premature ventricular complexes (PVCs), and atrial fibrillation (AF). Some procedures cannot be performed without CS access, requiring alternative approaches when cannulation fails. CS cannulation can be difficult and, rarely, unsuccessful. Known causes include anatomical abnormalities such as atresia, diverticulum, anomalous ostial location, and fixed stenosis at the ostium or along the vessel course. Here, we present three cases of difficult CS cannulation due to dynamic obstruction - a novel anatomical variant. Methods: We describe three consecutive patients referred for CRT-D implantation in whom CS cannulation or lead advancement was unexpectedly difficult. In each case, standard CS sheath and catheter techniques were used via subclavian venous access. When resistance to catheter or lead advancement was encountered, contrast venography (with balloon occlusion in select cases) was performed to delineate CS anatomy across the cardiac cycle, and catheter/lead manipulation timed to the non-systolic phase was used to overcome the obstruction. Results: In all three patients, venography revealed dynamic narrowing of the CS main trunk or a branch during ventricular systole, with resolution of the compression during diastole - a pattern consistent with an underlying muscle bridge rather than a fixed structural lesion. Case 1 showed severe systolic compression of the CS main trunk at the posterolateral branch takeoff; Case 2 showed a similar constriction in the mid-CS body; Case 3 showed compression confined to the distal lateral branch. Despite these dynamic obstructions, successful CS lead placement was achieved in all three patients using gentle catheter manipulation and advancement timed to diastole, without need for alternative pacing approaches. Conclusions: Dynamic, systole-phase compression of the coronary sinus or its branches - attributable to an epicardial-to-intramyocardial muscle bridge - represents a previously underrecognized and reversible cause of CS cannulation difficulty, distinct from fixed anatomical anomalies. Recognition of this pattern on cine-venography, combined with balloon-occlusion imaging and diastole-timed catheter advancement, allows most cases to be managed successfully without abandoning the CS approach

AI.tldr: 三例CRT-D植入患者因冠状窦在收缩期动态受压（肌桥）导致插管困难，经球囊闭塞静脉造影识别并于舒张期推进导管，均成功植入左室导线。
AI.motivation: 冠状窦（CS）入路是CRT、左侧旁路及PVC/AF消融等电生理操作的关键环节，插管失败时需改用替代方案。既往已知的插管困难原因多为固定性解剖异常（闭锁、憩室、开口异位、固定狭窄），而动态性、收缩期加重的CS受压此前未被认识，可能导致术者误判为固定梗阻而放弃CS入路。
AI.method: 单中心病例系列，连续纳入3例因心力衰竭接受CRT-D植入的患者。均经锁骨下静脉入路，使用标准CS鞘与导管；遇推进阻力时行静脉造影（部分病例加球囊闭塞），对比心脏周期各时相的CS形态，并将导管/导线操作定时于非收缩期（舒张期）以越过梗阻。终点为CS插管及左室导线植入是否成功、是否需改用替代起搏方式。
AI.result: 3例静脉造影均显示CS主干或分支在心室收缩期动态狭窄、舒张期压迫解除，符合肌桥而非固定病变：例1为主干后外侧支开口处重度收缩期受压，例2为CS中段，例3为远端侧支。3例均通过轻柔操作并于舒张期推进导管成功完成CS导线植入，无需替代起搏途径。摘要未报告定量狭窄程度、压力阶差及随访数据。
AI.conclusion: 收缩期动态压迫CS或其分支（心外膜至心肌内肌桥）是CS插管困难中可逆、可被忽视的原因，区别于固定解剖异常。 cine-静脉造影识别该征象、结合球囊闭塞成像与舒张期定时推进导管，可使多数病例避免放弃CS入路。该发现对CRT植入及依赖CS的消融操作具有实践意义；但证据仅来自3例病例系列，发生率、可重复性及长期导线稳定性尚待更大样本验证。

summary_zh: 目的：冠状静脉窦（CS）在心脏电生理中发挥关键作用，包括心脏再同步治疗（CRT）以及左侧旁路、室性早搏（PVC）和心房颤动（AF）等心律失常的消融。某些操作若无CS入路则无法进行，当插管失败时需要替代方法。CS插管可能困难，罕见情况下无法成功。已知原因包括解剖异常，如闭锁、憩室、开口位置异常以及开口处或血管走行中的固定性狭窄。在此，我们报告三例因动态梗阻——一种新的解剖变异——导致CS插管困难的病例。方法：我们描述了三例连续转诊接受CRT-D植入的患者，其CS插管或导线推进意外困难。每例均通过锁骨下静脉入路使用标准CS鞘管和导管技术。当遇到导管或导线推进阻力时，进行对比静脉造影（部分病例采用球囊阻断）以显示整个心动周期的CS解剖，并采用与收缩期非同步的导管/导线操作以克服梗阻。结果：所有三例患者的静脉造影均显示收缩期CS主干或分支的动态狭窄，舒张期压迫缓解——这一模式符合潜在的肌桥而非固定性结构病变。病例1显示后侧支发出处CS主干的严重收缩期压迫；病例2显示CS中段类似的缩窄；病例3显示压迫局限于远端侧支。尽管存在这些动态梗阻，所有三例患者均通过轻柔的导管操作和舒张期定时推进成功完成CS导线放置，无需替代起搏方法。结论：冠状静脉窦或其分支的收缩期动态压迫——可归因于心外膜至心肌内的肌桥——是先前未被充分认识且可逆的CS插管困难原因，区别于固定性解剖异常。在电影静脉造影上识别这一模式，结合球囊阻断成像和舒张期定时导管推进，可使大多数病例成功处理而无需放弃CS入路。

title: Serum Potassium and Mineralocorticoid Receptor Antagonists As Modifiers of Atrial Arrhythmia Recurrence After Catheter Ablation for Atrial Fibrillation: A Narrative Review With Systematic Search and Mechanistic Synthesis.
summary: Atrial arrhythmia recurrence after catheter ablation for atrial fibrillation (AF) remains common despite advances in pulmonary vein isolation, mapping, lesion delivery, and rhythm monitoring. Contemporary guidelines emphasize integrated, risk-factor-based care, yet the roles of serum potassium management and mineralocorticoid receptor antagonist (MRA) therapy after ablation remain poorly defined. We aimed to synthesize the clinical and mechanistic evidence on whether serum potassium, potassium-management strategies, and MRA therapy (steroidal: spironolactone, eplerenone; nonsteroidal: esaxerenone, finerenone) modify recurrence, and to derive a testable mechanistic framework. Considering these backgrounds, we conducted a narrative review supported by a systematic literature search, prepared with reference to the PRISMA 2020 principles for transparency of search and selection and, because clinical heterogeneity precluded meta-analysis, the Synthesis Without Meta-analysis (SWiM) guideline. PubMed/MEDLINE and public professional society repositories were searched from inception to 6 June 2026, supplemented by hand searching; eligibility was prespecified using a PICOS framework. Study selection and extraction were performed in duplicate. The risk of bias was assessed using RoB 2 (randomized trials) and ROBINS-I (non-randomized studies). Findings were synthesized narratively across a prespecified evidence hierarchy (direct, indirect, mechanistic). Direct evidence was limited to five studies and was constrained by heterogeneity, small sample sizes in the MRA studies, and moderate-to-serious risk of bias in most non-randomized comparisons. One registry cohort (n = 4,838) reported a U-shaped association between preprocedural potassium and one-year recurrence, with the lowest observed risk at 4.41-4.60 mmol/L; however, this observational association does not establish an optimal therapeutic target or benefit from supplementation. Among four small/heterogeneous MRA studies, eplerenone and a single-center spironolactone randomized trial showed favorable recurrence signals, whereas retrospective esaxerenone showed no recurrence reduction despite improvements in secondary biomarker and remodeling measures; another study used renal sympathetic denervation as an active comparator and therefore did not establish MRA benefit over usual care. These findings should be interpreted cautiously because of study limitations, imprecision, confounding by indication, and variable recurrence ascertainment. Indirect evidence from non-ablation populations and mechanistic studies supports biological plausibility for interactions among potassium homeostasis, mineralocorticoid signaling, renal function, and atrial remodeling, but cannot validate a post-ablation treatment strategy. Accordingly, the proposed ionic-renal-aldosterone-fibrosis axis should be regarded as a hypothesis-generating framework rather than a clinically validated mechanism. Current evidence supports avoiding hypokalemia and hyperkalemia, correcting reversible disturbances, and prescribing MRAs for established indications with appropriate monitoring; it does not justify routine potassium supplementation or MRA use solely to prevent post-ablation recurrence. Prospective, adequately powered randomized studies with longitudinal potassium assessment and rigorous rhythm monitoring are required before mechanism-based post-ablation interventions can be recommended.

AI.tldr: 本叙述性综述结合系统检索发现，现有证据不支持常规补钾或仅以预防消融后复发为目的使用MRA，仅建议避免血钾异常并按适应证使用MRA。
AI.motivation: 房颤导管消融后房性心律失常复发仍常见，指南强调基于危险因素的综合管理，但血清钾管理和盐皮质激素受体拮抗剂（MRA）在消融后的作用尚不明确，需要整合临床与机制证据。
AI.method: 叙述性综述，参照PRISMA 2020原则进行系统文献检索，因临床异质性未行meta分析，采用SWiM指南进行叙述性综合。检索PubMed/MEDLINE及专业学会数据库（建库至2026年6月6日），辅以手工检索，预设PICOS框架，双人筛选与提取，采用RoB 2和ROBINS-I评估偏倚风险，按直接、间接、机制证据层级进行叙述性综合。
AI.result: 直接证据仅5项研究，异质性大、MRA研究样本量小、多数非随机比较偏倚风险为中至严重。一项注册队列（n=4,838）显示术前血钾与1年复发呈U型关联，最低风险见于4.41-4.60 mmol/L，但为观察性关联。4项小型/异质性MRA研究中，依普利酮和单中心螺内酯随机试验显示有利的复发信号，回顾性艾沙利酮研究虽改善次要生物标志物和重构指标但未减少复发，另一项研究以肾交感神经去神经为活性对照，未能确立MRA优于常规治疗。间接证据支持钾稳态、盐皮质激素信号、肾功能与心房重构相互作用的生物学合理性，但不能验证消融后治疗策略。
AI.conclusion: 当前证据支持避免低钾和高钾血症、纠正可逆性紊乱，并按已确立适应证使用MRA并适当监测；不支持仅以预防消融后复发为目的常规补钾或使用MRA。所提出的离子-肾脏-醛固酮-纤维化轴为假设生成框架，需前瞻性、足够把握度的随机研究结合纵向血钾评估和严格心律监测进一步验证。

summary_zh: 背景：尽管在肺静脉隔离、标测、损伤递送和节律监测方面取得了进展，心房颤动（AF）导管消融后房性心律失常复发仍然常见。当代指南强调基于危险因素的整合管理，然而消融后血清钾管理和盐皮质激素受体拮抗剂（MRA）治疗的作用仍不明确。目的：我们旨在综合关于血清钾、钾管理策略和MRA治疗（甾体类：螺内酯、依普利酮；非甾体类：艾沙利酮、非奈利酮）是否改变复发的临床和机制证据，并推导出一个可检验的机制框架。方法：鉴于这些背景，我们进行了一项叙述性综述，并辅以系统性文献检索，参考PRISMA 2020原则以保证检索和筛选的透明度，并且由于临床异质性无法进行荟萃分析，参考了无荟萃分析综合（SWiM）指南。检索了PubMed/MEDLINE和公共专业学会数据库，从建库至2026年6月6日，并辅以手工检索；使用PICOS框架预先指定纳入标准。研究筛选和数据提取由两人独立完成。使用RoB 2（随机试验）和ROBINS-I（非随机研究）评估偏倚风险。结果按照预先指定的证据等级（直接、间接、机制）进行叙述性综合。结果：直接证据仅限于五项研究，并受到异质性、MRA研究样本量小以及大多数非随机比较存在中至重度偏倚风险的限制。一项注册队列（n = 4,838）报告了术前钾与一年复发之间的U型关联，观察到的最低风险在4.41-4.60 mmol/L；然而，这种观察性关联并不能确立最佳治疗目标或补充钾的获益。在四项小型/异质性MRA研究中，依普利酮和一项单中心螺内酯随机试验显示有利的复发信号，而回顾性艾沙利酮研究尽管在次要生物标志物和重构指标上有改善，但未显示复发减少；另一项研究使用肾交感神经去支配作为活性对照，因此未能确立MRA优于常规治疗的获益。由于研究局限性、不精确性、适应证混杂和复发判定方法不一，这些发现应谨慎解读。来自非消融人群和机制研究的间接证据支持钾稳态、盐皮质激素信号、肾功能和心房重构之间相互作用的生物学合理性，但不能验证消融后治疗策略。因此，提出的离子-肾脏-醛固酮-纤维化轴应被视为一个产生假设的框架，而非临床验证的机制。结论：当前证据支持避免低钾血症和高钾血症，纠正可逆性紊乱，并为已确立的适应证开具MRA处方并适当监测；它并不证明常规补钾或仅为了预防消融后复发而使用MRA是合理的。在推荐基于机制的消融后干预措施之前，需要进行前瞻性、有足够把握度的随机研究，并进行纵向钾评估和严格的节律监测。

title: Graves’ Disease and the Heart: Severe Reversible Left Ventricular Systolic Dysfunction With Apical Thrombus in a Young Woman With Relapsed Thyrotoxicosis
summary: Graves' disease is a common cause of autoimmune hyperthyroidism and is frequently associated with cardiovascular manifestations, including sinus tachycardia, atrial fibrillation and high-output heart failure.Severe left ventricular (LV) systolic dysfunction complicated by LV thrombus is an uncommon presentation.Recognition may be challenging when concurrent illness and antithyroid treatment complicate the interpretation of thyroid function tests.A 27-year-old woman with Graves' disease diagnosed in 2021 presented in March 2025 with progressive dyspnoea, orthopnoea, profound lethargy, jaundice and generalised oedema.Following relapse in September 2024, carbimazole had been recommenced, but adherence was suboptimal, and heart failure symptoms had developed over several months.Examination revealed sinus tachycardia, diffuse goitre, exophthalmos, hepatomegaly and marked anasarca.Community-acquired pneumonia was also diagnosed.Admission free thyroxine was 8.5 pmol/L (reference range: 8.9-17.3),thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH) was 0.48 mIU/L (0.30-4.40), and free triiodothyronine was unavailable.This biochemical pattern was interpreted in the clinical context as consistent with non-thyroidal illness.N-terminal pro-B-type natriuretic peptide (NT-proBNP) was elevated at 9,326 ng/L.Electrocardiography demonstrated sinus tachycardia, and transthoracic echocardiography showed LV dilatation with severe global systolic dysfunction and an estimated LV ejection fraction (LVEF) of approximately 10%.Contrastenhanced computed tomography demonstrated an LV apical thrombus and hepatic congestion.Graves' disease-associated myocardial dysfunction was considered an important contributor; however, tachycardiamediated dysfunction, myocarditis and critical illness-related myocardial dysfunction remained potential contributing causes.Management included adjustment of carbimazole, diuresis, bisoprolol, valsartan, spironolactone and dapagliflozin, alongside treatment of pneumonia.Therapeutic anticoagulation was initiated with enoxaparin, followed by intravenous unfractionated heparin and bridging to warfarin.Clinical improvement was accompanied by recovery of LVEF to 36% during admission, approximately 40% in June 2025 and 52%-54% on echocardiography in September 2025.Cardiac magnetic resonance imaging during the same time confirmed normal biventricular size and systolic function, with an LVEF of 54% and no residual intracardiac thrombus.A small area of nonspecific non-infarct-pattern fibrosis could represent previous myocarditis.Definitive thyroidectomy was planned.This case highlights severe but reversible LV systolic dysfunction with apical thrombus in a young woman with relapsed Graves' disease and suboptimal treatment adherence.Although the clinical course suggests a thyroid-related contribution, the myocardial dysfunction may have been multifactorial.The reduction in thyroid-stimulating immunoglobulins (TSIs) alongside cardiac recovery represents a temporal association and does not establish causation.Careful clinical assessment and cardiac imaging are essential to recognising significant cardiac involvement when thyroid biochemistry is complicated by concurrent illness.

AI.tldr: 27岁女性复发Graves病伴依从性差，出现重度可逆性左室收缩功能障碍（LVEF约10%）及左室心尖血栓，经抗心衰、抗凝及抗甲状腺治疗后LVEF恢复至54%，血栓消失。
AI.motivation: Graves病常伴心血管表现，但重度左室收缩功能障碍合并左室血栓罕见；当合并症和抗甲状腺治疗干扰甲状腺功能判读时，识别困难。本文报道一例以严重可逆性心肌病和左室血栓为表现的复发Graves病，提示临床需警惕。
AI.method: 单例病例报告。27岁女性，2021年诊断Graves病，2024年9月复发后重启卡比马唑但依从性差，2025年3月因进行性呼吸困难、端坐呼吸、乏力、黄疸和全身水肿入院。入院时合并社区获得性肺炎。检查包括甲状腺功能、NT-proBNP、心电图、经胸超声心动图、增强CT和心脏磁共振。治疗包括调整卡比马唑、利尿、比索洛尔、缬沙坦、螺内酯、达格列净、抗感染及抗凝（依诺肝素→普通肝素→华法林桥接）。
AI.result: 入院游离甲状腺素8.5 pmol/L（参考8.9-17.3），TSH 0.48 mIU/L（0.30-4.40），游离三碘甲状腺原氨酸未报告；NT-proBNP 9,326 ng/L。心电图示窦性心动过速；超声示左室扩大、弥漫性重度收缩功能减低，LVEF约10%；增强CT示左室心尖血栓和肝淤血。住院期间LVEF恢复至36%，2025年6月约40%，2025年9月超声52%-54%；同期心脏磁共振示双心室大小和收缩功能正常，LVEF 54%，无残留心内血栓，仅见小片非特异性非梗死型纤维化，可能提示既往心肌炎。计划行甲状腺切除术。
AI.conclusion: 本病例提示复发Graves病且治疗依从性差的患者可出现重度但可逆的左室收缩功能障碍合并左室血栓；心肌功能障碍可能为多因素（甲状腺相关、心动过速介导、心肌炎或危重症相关）。TSI下降与心脏恢复仅为时间关联，不能确立因果。临床应仔细评估并利用心脏影像识别甲状腺生化受干扰时的显著心脏受累。

summary_zh: Graves病是自身免疫性甲状腺功能亢进的常见病因，常伴有心血管表现，包括窦性心动过速、心房颤动和高输出量心力衰竭。严重左心室（LV）收缩功能障碍合并LV血栓是一种不常见的表现。当并发疾病和抗甲状腺治疗使甲状腺功能检查的解读复杂化时，识别可能具有挑战性。一名2021年诊断为Graves病的27岁女性于2025年3月就诊，表现为进行性呼吸困难、端坐呼吸、极度乏力、黄疸和全身性水肿。2024年9月复发后，已重新开始卡比马唑治疗，但依从性欠佳，心力衰竭症状在数月内逐渐出现。检查发现窦性心动过速、弥漫性甲状腺肿、突眼、肝大和明显全身水肿。同时诊断为社区获得性肺炎。入院时游离甲状腺素为8.5 pmol/L（参考范围：8.9-17.3），促甲状腺激素（TSH）为0.48 mIU/L（0.30-4.40），游离三碘甲状腺原氨酸不可用。这一生化模式结合临床背景被解读为符合非甲状腺疾病。N末端B型利钠肽原（NT-proBNP）升高至9,326 ng/L。心电图显示窦性心动过速，经胸超声心动图显示LV扩张伴严重整体收缩功能障碍，估计LV射血分数（LVEF）约为10%。增强计算机断层扫描显示LV心尖血栓和肝淤血。Graves病相关的心肌功能障碍被认为是重要因素；然而，心动过速介导的功能障碍、心肌炎和危重病相关心肌功能障碍仍是潜在的 contributing 原因。管理包括调整卡比马唑、利尿、比索洛尔、缬沙坦、螺内酯和达格列净，同时治疗肺炎。开始依诺肝素治疗性抗凝，随后静脉给予普通肝素并桥接至华法林。临床改善伴随LVEF在住院期间恢复至36%，2025年6月约为40%，2025年9月超声心动图显示为52%-54%。同期心脏磁共振成像确认双心室大小和收缩功能正常，LVEF为54%，无残留心内血栓。一小片非特异性非梗死模式纤维化可能代表既往心肌炎。计划行决定性甲状腺切除术。本病例强调了一名复发Graves病且治疗依从性欠佳的年轻女性出现严重但可逆的LV收缩功能障碍伴心尖血栓。尽管临床过程提示甲状腺相关因素，但心肌功能障碍可能是多因素的。甲状腺刺激免疫球蛋白（TSIs）的下降与心脏恢复同时发生，代表时间关联，并未确立因果关系。当甲状腺生化因并发疾病而复杂化时，仔细的临床评估和心脏影像学对于识别显著心脏受累至关重要。

title: Can ARNI Prevent Atrial Fibrillation in Heart Failure with Reduced Ejection Fraction? Real-World Evidence Meets the Randomized Benchmark.
summary: Enrico Volpe, Stanislovas Jankauskas, Pasquale Mone, Shivangi Pande, Maria Laura Danza, Gaetano Santulli; Can ARNI Prevent Atrial Fibrillation in Heart Fai

AI.tldr: 在HFrEF患者中，真实世界数据显示ARNI较ACEI/ARB显著降低新发房颤风险，与随机对照试验基准方向一致。

title: Impact of differences in kidney function estimation by creatinine compared to cystatin C on clinical outcomes in patients with atrial fibrillation
summary: Aims Differences between cystatin C-based and creatinine-based glomerular filtration rate estimations (eGFRdiff) have been associated with adverse outcomes. We aimed to investigate the prevalence of eGFRdiff and its association with clinical outcomes and brain lesions in patients with atrial fibrillation (AF).Methods and results We analysed 3804 patients with AF enrolled in two prospective, multicentre cohort studies. The eGFRdiff was calculated by 'cystatin C-based eGFR-creatinine-based eGFR'. Patients were stratified into three groups: eGFRdiff >10, -10 to 10, and <-10 mL/min/1.73 m². Associations with high-sensitivity troponin T (hs-TnT), NT-proBNP, major adverse cardiovascular (CV) events (stroke/systemic embolism, myocardial infarction and CV death), first heart failure (HF) hospitalization, and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)-detected brain lesions were assessed. The mean age was 71 years, 28% were female, and 49% had paroxysmal AF. An eGFRdiff of >10, -10 to 10, and <-10 mL/min/1.73 m2 was present in 17.7%, 71.7%, and 10.6% of the patients, respectively. Incidence rates per 100 patient-years increased across these groups for major CV events (MACEs: 1.7, 3.9, 6.8) and HF hospitalization (1.2, 3.5, 6.1). Similarly, the prevalence of MRI-detected brain infarcts (28%, 39%, 42%) and moderate-to-severe white matter hyperintensities (38%, 55%, 63%) increased with greater eGFRdiff. The levels of hs-TnT and NT-proBNP were inversely correlated with eGFRdiff. In multivariable-adjusted linear models, lower eGFRdiff was associated with MACE (P = 0.006) and HF hospitalization (P = 0.015).Conclusion A substantial proportion of patients with AF exhibit clinically relevant eGFRdiff. More negative eGFR difference was associated with elevated cardiac biomarkers, greater burden of ischaemic brain lesions, and increased risk of CV events and HF hospitalization.Clinicaltrialsgov identifier NCT02105844.

AI.tldr: 在房颤患者中，基于胱抑素C与肌酐估算的eGFR差值（eGFRdiff）普遍存在，更负的eGFRdiff与心血管事件、心衰住院及脑缺血病灶负担增加相关。
AI.motivation: 基于胱抑素C和基于肌酐的eGFR估算值差异（eGFRdiff）与不良结局相关，但其在房颤患者中的患病率及其与临床结局和脑部病灶的关系尚不明确。
AI.method: 分析两项前瞻性多中心队列研究中的3804例房颤患者，计算eGFRdiff（胱抑素C-based eGFR减去肌酐-based eGFR），分为>10、-10至10、<-10 mL/min/1.73 m²三组。评估其与高敏肌钙蛋白T、NT-proBNP、主要不良心血管事件（卒中/系统性栓塞、心肌梗死、心血管死亡）、首次心衰住院及MRI检测脑部病灶的相关性，采用多变量校正线性模型。
AI.result: 平均年龄71岁，女性28%，阵发性房颤49%。eGFRdiff >10、-10至10、<-10组分别占17.7%、71.7%、10.6%。三组主要心血管事件发生率（每100患者年）分别为1.7、3.9、6.8，心衰住院分别为1.2、3.5、6.1。MRI检测脑梗死患病率分别为28%、39%、42%，中重度白质高信号分别为38%、55%、63%。hs-TnT和NT-proBNP水平与eGFRdiff呈负相关。多变量校正模型中，较低eGFRdiff与主要心血管事件（P=0.006）和心衰住院（P=0.015）相关。
AI.conclusion: 相当比例的房颤患者存在临床相关的eGFRdiff。更负的eGFRdiff与心脏生物标志物升高、缺血性脑病灶负担加重及心血管事件和心衰住院风险增加相关，提示eGFRdiff可能有助于房颤患者的风险分层。

结论：相当比例的AF患者存在具有临床相关性的eGFRdiff。更负的eGFR差异与心脏生物标志物升高、缺血性脑病变负担加重以及CV事件和HF住院风险增加相关。Clinicaltrialsgov标识符：NCT02105844。

title: Disappearance of local ventricular components during extrastimulus pacing after ultra-low-temperature cryoablation for ventricular tachycardia: a case report
summary: Background: Ultra-low-temperature cryoablation (ULTC) enables the creation of deep and potentially transmural myocardial lesions and is increasingly used for ventricular tachycardia (VT) substrate modification. However, the chronic electrophysiological properties of myocardium following extreme cryothermal injury remain incompletely understood. Case summary: A 66-year-old man with dilated cardiomyopathy and a cardiac resynchronization therapy defibrillator presented with recurrent sustained VT 15 months after ULTC of the left ventricular outflow tract. During repeat ablation, high-density mapping revealed sharp local ventricular electrograms within the prior ablation region. Programmed ventricular stimulation from the right ventricular outflow tract reproducibly induced disappearance of these sharp local components during extrastimulus pacing, while the surface QRS complex remained preserved, indicating preserved global ventricular activation. The phenomenon was consistently observed across different pacing protocols. Radiofrequency ablation targeting this region resulted in elimination of the sharp local electrograms, whereas dull far-field signals persisted. After ablation, VT was no longer inducible, and the patient remained free from recurrence at 3-month follow-up. Discussion: This case demonstrates a reproducible disappearance of near-field ventricular electrograms during extrastimulus pacing in myocardium previously treated with ULTC. The findings suggest localized refractoriness or source-sink mismatch within partially injured myocardium, rather than conventional slow conduction. These observations provide novel insight into the chronic electrophysiological effects that may occur after ULTC and may have implications for substrate assessment during repeat VT ablation.

AI.tldr: ULTC后复发VT患者，在重复消融时发现起搏刺激下局部心室电图消失而体表QRS保留，提示部分损伤心肌的局部不应期或源-汇 mismatch，而非传统慢传导。
AI.motivation: ULTC可产生深部透壁心肌损伤，越来越多用于VT基质改良，但极端冷冻损伤后心肌的慢性电生理特性尚不清楚，影响重复消融时的基质评估。
AI.method: 病例报告。66岁男性扩张型心肌病、CRT-D患者，LVOT的ULTC后15个月复发持续性VT。重复消融时行高密度标测，从RVOT行程序电刺激，观察局部心室电图变化，并针对异常区域行射频消融，随访3个月。
AI.result: 高密度标测显示原消融区内有尖锐局部心室电图；RVOT程序电刺激可重复诱发这些尖锐局部成分在期外刺激时消失，而体表QRS保持完整，不同起搏方案下现象一致。靶向射频消融后尖锐局部电图消除、远场钝信号持续，VT不再可诱发，3个月随访无复发。
AI.conclusion: ULTC后慢性期心肌在期外刺激下可出现近场心室电图可重复性消失，提示局部不应期或源-汇 mismatch，而非传统慢传导；这为ULTC后基质评估提供了新见解，但仅为单例观察，需进一步研究验证。

summary_zh:
背景：超低温冷冻消融（ULTC）能够产生深部且可能透壁的心肌损伤，并越来越多地用于室性心动过速（VT）的基质改良。然而，极端冷冻热损伤后心肌的慢性电生理特性仍不完全清楚。

病例摘要：一名66岁男性，患有扩张型心肌病并植入心脏再同步治疗除颤器，在左心室流出道ULTC后15个月出现复发性持续性VT。在重复消融过程中，高密度标测显示先前消融区域内存在尖锐的局部心室电图。来自右心室流出道的程序心室刺激在期外刺激起搏期间可重复地诱导这些尖锐局部成分消失，而表面QRS波群保持完好，表明整体心室激动保留。该现象在不同起搏方案中一致观察到。针对该区域的射频消融导致尖锐局部电图消除，而钝的远场信号持续存在。消融后，VT不再可诱发，患者在3个月随访时无复发。

讨论：本病例展示了在先前接受ULTC治疗的心肌中，期外刺激起搏期间近场心室电图的可重复消失。这些发现提示部分损伤心肌内存在局部不应期或源-汇不匹配，而非传统的缓慢传导。这些观察为ULTC后可能发生的慢性电生理效应提供了新见解，并可能对重复VT消融期间的基质评估具有意义。

title: Case report: A unified CTA-fluoroscopy roadmap for single-session pulsed field ablation and left atrial appendage occlusion
summary: Single-session pulsed field ablation (PFA) and left atrial appendage occlusion (LAAO) is a clinically attractive strategy for selected patients with atrial fibrillation who require both rhythm-control therapy and stroke-prevention intervention. However, the combined procedure requires the operator to maintain spatial orientation while moving from transseptal access to pulmonary vein targeting and then to appendage engagement and device deployment. In this retrospective, single-centre technical case series, we evaluated five consecutive patients undergoing single-session PFA and LAAO with computed tomography angiography (CTA)-fluoroscopy fusion as a unified anatomical roadmap. Pre-procedural CTA was registered to intraoperative DynaCT, and a simplified CTA-derived model of the left atrium, pulmonary veins, superior vena cava, interatrial septum, and left atrial appendage was overlaid on live fluoroscopy. The same registered roadmap was intended to be retained across transseptal access, PFA localization, and LAAO deployment. The workflow was fully implemented in four patients and interrupted in one because of workflow-related factors during early adoption. PFA and WATCHMAN implantation were completed in all patients. At 45-day CTA follow-up, no residual leak or device-related thrombus was observed. Quantitative registration error and component-specific image-processing times were not prospectively recorded, and no conventional-guidance comparator was available. This proof-of-concept case series demonstrates the feasibility of translating pre-procedural CTA planning into a retained intraprocedural fluoroscopic roadmap across the electrophysiological and structural phases of a single-session intervention.

AI.tldr: 5例房颤患者采用CTA-透视融合统一解剖路径行单次PFA联合左心耳封堵，4例完整实施，全部完成PFA与WATCHMAN植入，45天CTA无残余漏及器械相关血栓。
AI.motivation: 对同时需要节律控制与卒中预防的房颤患者，单次完成脉冲场消融（PFA）与左心耳封堵（LAAO）具有临床吸引力，但联合术式需术者在房间隔穿刺、肺静脉靶向、左心耳接合与器械释放之间反复重建空间定位，既往缺乏将术前CT规划贯穿整个手术流程的统一影像路径证据。
AI.method: 回顾性、单中心技术病例系列，连续纳入5例接受单次PFA联合LAAO的患者。术前CTA与术中DynaCT配准，将简化的左房、肺静脉、上腔静脉、房间隔及左心耳模型叠加于实时透视，同一配准路径计划贯穿房间隔穿刺、PFA定位与LAAO释放。终点为工作流实施可行性、手术完成情况及45天CTA随访的残余漏与器械相关血栓；定量配准误差、各组件图像处理时间未前瞻性记录，无常规引导对照组。
AI.result: 工作流在4例中完整实施，1例因早期开展阶段的工作流相关因素中断。全部患者完成PFA与WATCHMAN植入。45天CTA随访未见残余漏或器械相关血栓。定量配准误差与分组件图像处理时间摘要未报告；无常规引导对照组的比较数据。
AI.conclusion: 该概念验证病例系列提示，将术前CTA规划转化为贯穿电生理与结构干预阶段的保留式术中透视路径具有可行性，可能减少联合术中的反复定位。但样本量小、为回顾性单中心设计、缺乏对照与定量精度数据，尚不能评价其相对常规引导的有效性与安全性，需前瞻性对照研究验证。

summary_zh: 单次脉冲场消融（PFA）联合左心耳封堵（LAAO）对于需要同时进行节律控制治疗和卒中预防干预的特定房颤患者是一种具有临床吸引力的策略。然而，联合手术要求术者在从房间隔穿刺入路转向肺静脉靶向，再转向心耳接合和器械释放的过程中保持空间定位。在这项回顾性、单中心技术病例系列中，我们评估了连续五例接受单次PFA和LAAO的患者，使用计算机断层扫描血管造影（CTA）-透视融合作为统一的解剖路径图。术前CTA配准至术中DynaCT，并将简化的CTA衍生模型（包括左心房、肺静脉、上腔静脉、房间隔和左心耳）叠加在实时透视图像上。同一配准路径图计划在房间隔穿刺入路、PFA定位和LAAO释放过程中保留。该工作流程在四例患者中完全实施，在一例中因早期采用阶段的工作流程相关因素而中断。所有患者均完成了PFA和WATCHMAN植入。在45天CTA随访时，未观察到残余漏或器械相关血栓。定量配准误差和组件特异性图像处理时间未前瞻性记录，且无常规引导对照。这项概念验证病例系列表明，将术前CTA规划转化为保留的术中透视路径图，贯穿单次介入的电生理和结构阶段是可行的。

title: Atrial strain as an imaging biomarker of subclinical atrial fibrillation in embolic stroke of undetermined source
summary: Abstract Objective This study aims to evaluate left atrial (LA) strain as an imaging biomarker for predicting subclinical atrial fibrillation (AF) in embolic stroke of undetermined source (ESUS) patients undergoing long-term rhythm monitoring with implantable loop recorders (ILR). Methods Retrospectively study of 67 ESUS patients who underwent ILR implantation. LA strain was assessed using speckle-tracking echocardiography (STE). Global peak atrial longitudinal strain (PALS) and peak atrial contraction strain (PACS) were quantified. Intra- and interobserver reproducibility were evaluated. Subclinical AF was considered stroke-related if detected within 12 months. Statistical analyses included regression models, ROC analysis, Kaplan–Meier survival curves, and Cox proportional hazards models. Results Subclinical AF was detected in 16 patients (23.9%). Patients who developed AF exhibited significantly reduced global PALS. PALS demonstrated excellent intra- and interobserver reproducibility (ICC >0.9). ROC analysis identified a global PALS cutoff <25.50% as a sensitive predictor of subclinical AF. In multivariable analysis, reduced PALS and lower left atrial volume index (LAVI) were independent predictors of AF. Time-to-event analysis confirmed shorter AF-free survival in patients with impaired PALS. Conclusions Quantitative assessment of LA mechanical function using STE identifies early atrial dysfunction associated with subclinical AF in ESUS patients. Reduced PALS appears to precede atrial dilation, supporting its role as a functional imaging biomarker of atrial cardiomyopathy.

AI.tldr: 在67例ESUS患者中，斑点追踪超声测得的左房整体纵向应变（PALS）降低可独立预测植入式心电记录器检出的亚临床房颤，且PALS<25.50%为敏感切点。
AI.motivation: ESUS患者中亚临床房颤是重要卒中病因，但缺乏简便的影像学预测指标；左房应变能否作为房性心肌病标志物预测亚临床房颤尚不明确。
AI.method: 回顾性研究纳入67例植入ILR的ESUS患者，用斑点追踪超声测量左房整体纵向应变（PALS）和收缩期应变（PACS），评估观察者内和观察者间可重复性；亚临床房颤定义为12个月内检出并与卒中相关；采用回归模型、ROC分析、Kaplan-Meier生存曲线和Cox比例风险模型进行统计。
AI.result: 16例（23.9%）检出亚临床房颤；房颤组整体PALS显著降低；PALS观察者内和观察者间可重复性极佳（ICC>0.9）；ROC分析确定PALS<25.50%为敏感预测切点；多变量分析显示PALS降低和左房容积指数（LAVI）较低是房颤的独立预测因素；时间-事件分析证实PALS受损者无房颤生存期更短。
AI.conclusion: 斑点追踪超声定量评估左房机械功能可识别ESUS患者中与亚临床房颤相关的早期心房功能障碍；PALS降低似乎先于心房扩大，支持其作为房性心肌病功能影像标志物，有助于筛选需长期心律监测的高危患者；但样本量小且为回顾性研究，切点需前瞻性验证。

summary_zh: 摘要 目的 本研究旨在评估左心房（LA）应变作为影像生物标志物，用于预测接受植入式循环记录仪（ILR）长期心律监测的栓塞性卒中不明原因（ESUS）患者中的亚临床心房颤动（AF）。方法 回顾性研究67例接受ILR植入的ESUS患者。使用斑点追踪超声心动图（STE）评估LA应变。量化整体心房纵向峰值应变（PALS）和心房收缩峰值应变（PACS）。评估观察者内和观察者间可重复性。若在12个月内检测到亚临床AF，则认为其与卒中相关。统计分析包括回归模型、ROC分析、Kaplan–Meier生存曲线和Cox比例风险模型。结果 16例患者（23.9%）检测到亚临床AF。发生AF的患者整体PALS显著降低。PALS表现出优异的观察者内和观察者间可重复性（ICC >0.9）。ROC分析确定整体PALS截断值<25.50%是亚临床AF的敏感预测指标。在多变量分析中，PALS降低和左心房容积指数（LAVI）较低是AF的独立预测因素。时间-事件分析证实，PALS受损患者的无AF生存期较短。结论 使用STE定量评估LA机械功能可识别ESUS患者中与亚临床AF相关的早期心房功能障碍。PALS降低似乎先于心房扩张，支持其作为心房心肌病功能影像生物标志物的作用。

title: Impedance changes during intracardiac echocardiography-confirmed catheter contact in pulsed field ablation.
summary:
PURPOSE: Pulsed field ablation (PFA) has become an established treatment modality for atrial fibrillation (AF). Adequate catheter-to-tissue contact is essential for effective energy delivery. However, impedance characteristics associated with directly visualized catheter contact during PFA have not been well characterized. We evaluated impedance changes measured by the Contact Index during intracardiac echocardiography (ICE)-confirmed catheter contact.

METHODS: We retrospectively analyzed 30 consecutive patients who underwent index PFA for AF using a pentaspline catheter under a novel impedance measurement system (EnSite X, Abbott). Impedance changes in each pulmonary vein (PV) using both basket and flower configurations were measured. Catheter-to-tissue contact was confirmed by ICE positioned within the left atrium, and impedance changes associated with ICE-confirmed catheter contact were analyzed.

RESULTS: A total of 2400 impedance measurements were analyzed. Median impedance changes ranged from 22% to 25% across pulmonary veins. Linear mixed-effects analysis demonstrated that both pulmonary vein location (P < 0.001) and catheter configuration (P < 0.001) were independently associated with impedance change, whereas no significant interaction was observed between pulmonary vein location and catheter configuration (P = 0.084).

CONCLUSIONS: This study characterizes the distribution of impedance changes observed during ICE-confirmed catheter contact across different pulmonary veins and catheter configurations. These findings provide device-specific descriptive reference data for future prospective validation studies.

AI.tldr: 在ICE确认导管接触的PFA术中，肺静脉各部位阻抗变化中位数为22%-25%，且肺静脉位置和导管构型是阻抗变化的独立影响因素。
AI.motivation: PFA已成为房颤的成熟治疗方式，有效能量递送依赖导管与组织的充分接触，但PFA过程中直接可视化的导管接触所对应的阻抗特征尚未被充分描述，本研究旨在评估ICE确认接触下Contact Index测得的阻抗变化。
AI.method: 回顾性分析30例连续接受首次PFA的房颤患者，使用五分支导管和EnSite X阻抗测量系统，分别测量篮状和花瓣状构型下各肺静脉的阻抗变化，由左心房内ICE确认导管-组织接触，分析接触相关的阻抗变化，采用线性混合效应模型评估影响因素。
AI.result: 共分析2400次阻抗测量，各肺静脉阻抗变化中位数为22%-25%。线性混合效应分析显示，肺静脉位置（P < 0.001）和导管构型（P < 0.001）均独立与阻抗变化相关，二者无显著交互作用（P = 0.084）。
AI.conclusion: 本研究描述了ICE确认导管接触下不同肺静脉和导管构型的阻抗变化分布，为后续前瞻性验证研究提供了器械特异性描述性参考数据；但为单中心回顾性设计，样本量有限，结论需前瞻性研究验证。

summary_zh:
目的：脉冲场消融（PFA）已成为治疗心房颤动（AF）的既定治疗方式。充分的导管与组织接触对于有效输送能量至关重要。然而，在PFA过程中与直接可视化的导管接触相关的阻抗特征尚未得到充分表征。我们评估了在心腔内超声（ICE）确认导管接触期间，通过接触指数测量的阻抗变化。

方法：我们回顾性分析了30例连续患者，这些患者使用五分支导管在新颖的阻抗测量系统（EnSite X，Abbott）下接受了针对AF的首次PFA。测量了使用篮状和花状两种构型时每根肺静脉（PV）的阻抗变化。通过置于左心房内的ICE确认导管与组织接触，并分析了与ICE确认的导管接触相关的阻抗变化。

结果：共分析了2400次阻抗测量。各肺静脉的中位阻抗变化范围为22%至25%。线性混合效应分析表明，肺静脉位置（P < 0.001）和导管构型（P < 0.001）均与阻抗变化独立相关，而肺静脉位置与导管构型之间未观察到显著交互作用（P = 0.084）。

结论：本研究表征了在不同肺静脉和导管构型下，ICE确认导管接触期间观察到的阻抗变化分布。这些发现为未来的前瞻性验证研究提供了器械特定的描述性参考数据。

title: Ariadne's thread: a standardized mapping workflow using a pentaspline pulsed-field ablation catheter for pulmonary vein isolation
summary: Background Pentaspline pulsed-field ablation (PFA) catheters with integrated three-dimensional mapping allow anatomical reconstruction and ablation with a single device. However, standardized catheter-manipulation workflows for reproducible left atrial mapping with these systems remain limited.Technique Ariadne's Thread is a standardized pulmonary vein (PV)-anchored mapping workflow based on sequential guidewire positioning in each PV, basket-configuration acquisition, gradual catheter pullback from the PV sleeve to the ostium and antrum, and controlled sheath rotation. Repetition of this sequence from the four PVs generates intersecting trajectories that provide broad PV-antral and posterior left atrial coverage, while roof acquisition is completed by reducing guidewire tension and redirecting the basket superiorly.Practical considerations The workflow is intended for PVI/posterior wall isolation (PWI)-oriented anatomical reconstruction rather than comprehensive high-density substrate mapping. Anterior left atrial, left atrial appendage-PV ridge, septal, and narrow conduction-channel regions may be incompletely sampled and should be assessed with supplementary targeted or dedicated high-density mapping when clinically required.Conclusions Ariadne's Thread provides a structured single-catheter approach to left atrial anatomical mapping during PFA-based PVI/PWI, standardizing catheter manipulation while defining the anatomical scope and limitations of the technique.

AI.tldr: Ariadne's Thread是一种基于五分支脉冲场消融导管的标准化左房标测流程，通过导丝锚定和篮状构型实现肺静脉及后壁覆盖，但前壁等区域可能采样不全。
AI.motivation: 五分支脉冲场消融导管整合三维标测可单器械完成解剖重建与消融，但缺乏标准化导管操作流程以保证左房标测的可重复性。
AI.method: 技术描述性研究，提出Ariadne's Thread标准化流程：依次将导丝置入四支肺静脉，篮状构型采集，从肺静脉袖部逐步回撤至开口和前庭，并控制鞘管旋转；重复序列形成交叉轨迹覆盖肺静脉前庭和后壁，通过减少导丝张力并向上调整篮状完成顶部采集。该流程面向肺静脉隔离/后壁隔离的解剖重建，非全面高密度基质标测。
AI.result: 摘要未报告定量数据（样本量、效应量、置信区间、P值均未报告）。流程可提供广泛的肺静脉前庭和后壁覆盖，但左房前壁、左心耳-肺静脉嵴、间隔及窄传导通道区域可能采样不全，临床需要时应补充靶向或专用高密度标测。
AI.conclusion: Ariadne's Thread为脉冲场消融肺静脉隔离/后壁隔离提供结构化单导管左房解剖标测流程，标准化导管操作并明确技术解剖范围和局限；其可重复性和临床获益尚需研究验证。

summary_zh: 背景：具有整合三维标测功能的五分支脉冲场消融（PFA）导管允许使用单一器械进行解剖重建和消融。然而，使用这些系统进行可重复的左心房标测的标准化导管操作工作流程仍然有限。技术：Ariadne's Thread 是一种标准化的肺静脉（PV）锚定标测工作流程，基于在每个 PV 中顺序放置导丝、篮状构型采集、导管从 PV 袖部逐渐回撤至开口和窦部，以及可控的鞘管旋转。从四个 PV 重复此序列会产生相交的轨迹，提供广泛的 PV-窦部和左心房后部覆盖，而顶部采集通过减少导丝张力并将篮状结构向上重定向来完成。实践考虑：该工作流程旨在用于 PVI/后壁隔离（PWI）导向的解剖重建，而非全面的高密度基质标测。左心房前部、左心耳-PV 嵴、间隔和狭窄传导通道区域可能采样不完整，当临床需要时应通过补充的靶向或专用高密度标测进行评估。结论：Ariadne's Thread 提供了一种结构化的单导管方法，用于基于 PFA 的 PVI/PWI 期间的左心房解剖标测，标准化了导管操作，同时定义了该技术的解剖范围和局限性。

title: ATRIAL FIBRILLATION, WEARABLE TECHNOLOGIES AND ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE: CURRENT EVIDENCE, CLINICAL UTILITY AND LIMITATIONS
summary: Background: Atrial fibrillation is the most common sustained cardiac arrhythmia in adults and represents an important clinical and public health problem because of its association with stroke, mortality, disability, and healthcare burden. Its paroxysmal and frequently asymptomatic course limits the effectiveness of conventional diagnostic strategies based on occasional electrocardiographic recordings. Aim: This narrative review aims to summarise current evidence regarding the use of wearable technologies and artificial intelligence for the detection of atrial fibrillation, with particular emphasis on diagnostic accuracy, clinical utility, and principal limitations. Methods: A structured literature search was performed using PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, and Google Scholar. Studies published between 2021 and 2026 were primarily considered. Search terms included “atrial fibrillation,” “wearable technologies,” “smartwatch,” “electrocardiography,” “photoplethysmography,” “artificial intelligence,” “machine learning,” and “diagnostics.” Priority was given to original studies, systematic reviews, meta-analyses, and clinically relevant review articles concerning wearable devices, artificial intelligence, and atrial fibrillation detection. Earlier landmark studies were included when they were necessary to explain key evidence discussed in recent reviews and meta-analyses. Results: Wearable devices such as smartwatches, fitness bands, and portable ECG systems allow longer heart rhythm monitoring in daily life and may help detect paroxysmal and clinically silent atrial fibrillation. ECG-based devices are more consistent with current diagnostic standards, whereas photoplethysmography-based systems are more accessible and can provide passive rhythm monitoring. Artificial intelligence, especially machine learning and deep learning, can support signal interpretation, arrhythmia recognition, and risk prediction. However, diagnostic performance reported in controlled studies may not always translate directly into real-world clinical practice. Conclusions: Wearable technologies and artificial intelligence offer a promising way to support atrial fibrillation screening and monitoring. They may improve early detection, especially in asymptomatic individuals, but should not replace standard diagnostic methods. Photoplethysmography-based alerts should be regarded as screening signals, while a final diagnosis of atrial fibrillation should still be confirmed by ECG in an appropriate clinical context. More large-scale studies are needed before these tools can be widely implemented in routine practice.
journal: International Journal of Innovative Technologies in Social Science

AI.tldr: 可穿戴设备与人工智能可延长房颤监测并提高无症状房颤的早期检出，但PPG提示仅属筛查信号，确诊仍需心电图。
AI.motivation: 房颤是成人最常见的持续性心律失常，与卒中、死亡、残疾及医疗负担相关；其阵发性和常无症状的特点使基于偶测心电图的传统诊断策略效果有限，需要评估可穿戴技术与人工智能在房颤检测中的诊断准确性、临床实用性和局限。
AI.method: 叙述性综述。检索PubMed、Scopus、Web of Science和Google Scholar，主要纳入2021至2026年发表的文献，检索词包括房颤、可穿戴技术、智能手表、心电图、光电容积脉搏波（PPG）、人工智能、机器学习与诊断等；优先纳入原始研究、系统综述、荟萃分析和临床相关综述，必要时纳入早期里程碑研究。摘要未报告纳入文献数量及系统评价方法学细节。
AI.result: 智能手表、健身手环和便携式心电系统可在日常生活中延长心律监测，有助于发现阵发性和临床沉默性房颤；基于心电图的设备与现行诊断标准更一致，基于PPG的系统更易获取并可提供被动心律监测。人工智能（尤其机器学习和深度学习）可辅助信号解读、心律失常识别和风险预测。但对照研究中报告的诊断性能不一定能直接转化到真实临床实践。摘要未报告具体的敏感度、特异度、95%CI或P值。
AI.conclusion: 可穿戴技术与人工智能为房颤筛查和监测提供了有前景的辅助手段，可能改善无症状人群的早期检出，但不应替代标准诊断方法；PPG警报应视为筛查信号，房颤最终诊断仍需在合适临床背景下由心电图确认。在广泛用于常规实践前，尚需更多大规模研究，且真实世界诊断准确性数据仍不充分。

summary_zh:
背景：心房颤动是成人中最常见的持续性心律失常，因其与卒中、死亡、残疾和医疗负担相关，构成了重要的临床和公共卫生问题。其阵发性和常无症状的病程限制了基于偶发心电图记录的常规诊断策略的有效性。

目的：本叙述性综述旨在总结关于使用可穿戴技术和人工智能检测心房颤动的当前证据，特别强调诊断准确性、临床实用性和主要局限性。

方法：使用PubMed、Scopus、Web of Science和Google Scholar进行了结构化的文献检索。主要考虑2021年至2026年间发表的研究。检索词包括“心房颤动”、“可穿戴技术”、“智能手表”、“心电图”、“光电容积脉搏波描记法”、“人工智能”、“机器学习”和“诊断学”。优先考虑关于可穿戴设备、人工智能和心房颤动检测的原创研究、系统综述、荟萃分析和临床相关综述文章。当需要解释近期综述和荟萃分析中讨论的关键证据时，纳入了更早的里程碑式研究。

结果：智能手表、健身手环和便携式心电图系统等可穿戴设备允许在日常生活中进行更长时程的心律监测，并可能有助于检测阵发性和临床无症状的心房颤动。基于心电图的设备更符合当前诊断标准，而基于光电容积脉搏波描记法的系统更易获取，并可提供被动心律监测。人工智能，特别是机器学习和深度学习，可以支持信号解读、心律失常识别和风险预测。然而，对照研究中报告的诊断性能可能并不总能直接转化为真实世界的临床实践。

结论：可穿戴技术和人工智能为支持心房颤动筛查和监测提供了有前景的途径。它们可能改善早期检测，尤其是在无症状个体中，但不应取代标准诊断方法。基于光电容积脉搏波描记法的警报应被视为筛查信号，而心房颤动的最终诊断仍应在适当的临床背景下通过心电图确认。在这些工具能够广泛实施于常规实践之前，需要更多大规模研究。

title: High-Density Spectral Analysis for Bi-Atrial Arrhythmogenic Substrate During Non-Paroxysmal Atrial Fibrillation.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Spectral analysis has been utilized to identify localized sites exhibiting high dominant frequency (DF) and high regularity-the critical arrhythmogenic substrate driving atrial fibrillation (AF). This study aimed to elucidate the spectral characteristics of focal activation (FoA) and rotational activation (RoA) sites during AF using a high-density mapping system.

METHODS: CARTOFINDER mapping was prospectively performed in both atria of 47 consecutive non-paroxysmal AF patients using the Octaray catheter prior to ablation. Endocardial unipolar electrograms were exported offline for spectral analysis of DF and the regularity index (RI).

RESULTS: CARTOFINDER assessed a total of 48 153 mapping points. Given substantial inter-subject variability in mean DF, the difference between each point's DF and the subject-level mean DF was defined as the dominant frequency deviation (DFD). The left atrium (LA) demonstrated significantly higher DFD and RI than the right atrium (both p < 0.001), with the LA roof recording the highest values across all segments. Both FoA and RoA sites exhibited significantly higher DFD and RI compared with sites without FoA and RoA (both p < 0.001). DFD and RI increased progressively with increasing FoA repetitions (both p < 0.001). In contrast, high-repetition RoA sites (> 16 repetitions) showed a significantly higher RI (0.42 ± 0.13 vs. 0.36 ± 0.12, p < 0.001) but a paradoxically lower DFD (0.14 ± 0.64 Hz vs. 0.26 ± 0.74 Hz, p < 0.001) compared with low-repetition RoA sites.

CONCLUSIONS: The combination of CARTOFINDER mapping and spectral analysis may contribute to the mechanistic understanding of non-paroxysmal AF.

AI.tldr: 在非阵发性房颤患者中，高密度标测显示左心房及局灶/旋转激动位点的优势频率偏差和规律性指数更高，且随局灶重复次数增加而递增。
AI.motivation: 频谱分析已用于识别高优势频率和高规律性的局部位点，这些位点是驱动房颤的关键致心律失常基质。本研究旨在利用高密度标测系统阐明房颤中局灶激动（FoA）和旋转激动（RoA）位点的频谱特征。
AI.method: 前瞻性纳入47例连续非阵发性房颤患者，在消融前使用Octaray导管通过CARTOFINDER系统对双心房进行标测。离线导出心内膜单极电图进行频谱分析，计算优势频率（DF）和规律性指数（RI）。因个体间平均DF差异大，定义每个点DF与个体平均DF的差值为优势频率偏差（DFD）。
AI.result: 共分析48,153个标测点。左心房DFD和RI均显著高于右心房（均p<0.001），左心房顶部在所有节段中记录到最高值。FoA和RoA位点的DFD和RI均显著高于无FoA/RoA位点（均p<0.001）。DFD和RI随FoA重复次数增加而递增（均p<0.001）。高重复次数RoA位点（>16次）的RI显著更高（0.42±0.13 vs. 0.36±0.12，p<0.001），但DFD反而更低（0.14±0.64 Hz vs. 0.26±0.74 Hz，p<0.001）。
AI.conclusion: CARTOFINDER标测结合频谱分析可能有助于理解非阵发性房颤的机制。左心房及局灶/旋转激动位点表现出更高的频谱偏差和规律性，但高重复旋转位点的DFD paradoxically降低，提示不同基质类型存在频谱异质性，需进一步研究其对消融策略的指导价值。

summary_zh:
背景：频谱分析已被用于识别表现出高优势频率（DF）和高规律性的局部区域——这是驱动心房颤动（AF）的关键致心律失常基质。本研究旨在利用高密度标测系统阐明AF期间局灶激动（FoA）和旋转激动（RoA）部位的频谱特征。

方法：使用Octaray导管在47例连续的非阵发性AF患者消融前前瞻性对双心房进行CARTOFINDER标测。心内膜单极电图被离线导出，用于DF和规律性指数（RI）的频谱分析。

结果：CARTOFINDER共评估了48 153个标测点。鉴于受试者间平均DF的显著变异性，将每个点的DF与受试者水平平均DF的差值定义为优势频率偏差（DFD）。左心房（LA）显示出显著高于右心房的DFD和RI（均p < 0.001），其中LA顶部在所有节段中记录到最高值。与无FoA和RoA的部位相比，FoA和RoA部位均表现出显著更高的DFD和RI（均p < 0.001）。DFD和RI随FoA重复次数增加而逐渐升高（均p < 0.001）。相反，与低重复次数的RoA部位相比，高重复次数RoA部位（> 16次重复）显示出显著更高的RI（0.42 ± 0.13 vs. 0.36 ± 0.12，p < 0.001），但DFD却反常地更低（0.14 ± 0.64 Hz vs. 0.26 ± 0.74 Hz，p < 0.001）。

结论：CARTOFINDER标测与频谱分析相结合可能有助于理解非阵发性AF的机制。

title: Catheter Ablation Versus Medical Therapy in Atrial Fibrillation With Heart Failure With Reduced or Mildly Reduced Ejection Fraction: A GRADE-Assessed Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Catheter ablation is an established rhythm-control strategy for atrial fibrillation (AF), but its effectiveness in patients with heart failure with reduced or mildly reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF/HFmrEF) remains incompletely defined. We performed a GRADE-assessed systematic review and meta-analysis comparing catheter ablation with conventional medical therapy in this population.

METHODS: PubMed, Embase, and the Cochrane Library were searched from inception to February 2026. Randomized controlled trials and observational cohort studies enrolling adults with AF and left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) ≤ 50% were included. Primary outcomes were all-cause mortality, cardiovascular mortality, and change in LVEF. Secondary outcomes were change in B-type natriuretic peptide (BNP) and cardiovascular hospitalization. Random-effects models were used, and certainty of evidence was assessed using GRADE.

RESULTS: Thirteen studies involving 131 492 participants were included. Catheter ablation significantly reduced all-cause mortality (RR 0.61, 95% CI 0.51-0.71) and cardiovascular mortality (RR 0.46, 95% CI 0.31-0.66), improved LVEF (MD 6.47%, 95% CI 4.47-8.47), and reduced BNP levels (MD -136.85 pg/mL, 95% CI -190.46 to -83.23). No significant reduction was observed in cardiovascular hospitalization (RR 0.78, 95% CI 0.53-1.13). Mortality benefits were consistent across subgroup analyses by study design and baseline LVEF.

CONCLUSIONS: Catheter ablation was associated with lower mortality and improved cardiac function compared with medical therapy in patients with AF and HFrEF/HFmrEF. Further studies specifically evaluating HFmrEF populations are warranted.

AI.tldr: 在AF合并HFrEF/HFmrEF患者中，导管消融较药物治疗显著降低全因死亡和心血管死亡，并改善LVEF和BNP，但未减少心血管住院。
AI.motivation: 导管消融是AF节律控制的成熟策略，但其在HFrEF/HFmrEF患者中的疗效证据尚不充分，需要系统评价比较导管消融与常规药物治疗的效果。
AI.method: GRADE评级的系统评价与荟萃分析，检索PubMed、Embase和Cochrane Library至2026年2月，纳入成人AF且LVEF≤50%的RCT和观察性队列研究，共13项研究131,492例参与者。主要终点为全因死亡、心血管死亡和LVEF变化；次要终点为BNP变化和心血管住院。采用随机效应模型，GRADE评估证据确定性。
AI.result: 导管消融显著降低全因死亡（RR 0.61，95% CI 0.51-0.71）和心血管死亡（RR 0.46，95% CI 0.31-0.66），改善LVEF（MD 6.47%，95% CI 4.47-8.47），降低BNP水平（MD -136.85 pg/mL，95% CI -190.46至-83.23）。心血管住院无显著减少（RR 0.78，95% CI 0.53-1.13）。按研究设计和基线LVEF的亚组分析中死亡获益一致。
AI.conclusion: 在AF合并HFrEF/HFmrEF患者中，导管消融与药物治疗相比与更低死亡率和改善心功能相关，支持其作为该人群的节律控制选择；但心血管住院未显著减少，且需针对HFmrEF人群开展进一步研究。

summary_zh:
背景：导管消融是心房颤动（AF）的既定节律控制策略，但其在射血分数降低或轻度降低的心力衰竭（HFrEF/HFmrEF）患者中的有效性仍未完全明确。我们进行了一项GRADE评估的系统综述和荟萃分析，比较该人群中导管消融与常规药物治疗。

方法：检索PubMed、Embase和Cochrane Library从建库至2026年2月。纳入纳入患有AF且左心室射血分数（LVEF）≤ 50%的成人的随机对照试验和观察性队列研究。主要结局为全因死亡率、心血管死亡率和LVEF变化。次要结局为B型利钠肽（BNP）变化和心血管住院。使用随机效应模型，并使用GRADE评估证据确定性。

结果：共纳入13项研究，涉及131 492名参与者。导管消融显著降低全因死亡率（RR 0.61，95% CI 0.51-0.71）和心血管死亡率（RR 0.46，95% CI 0.31-0.66），改善LVEF（MD 6.47%，95% CI 4.47-8.47），并降低BNP水平（MD -136.85 pg/mL，95% CI -190.46至-83.23）。未观察到心血管住院的显著减少（RR 0.78，95% CI 0.53-1.13）。按研究设计和基线LVEF进行的亚组分析中，死亡率获益一致。

结论：在AF和HFrEF/HFmrEF患者中，与药物治疗相比，导管消融与较低的死亡率和改善的心功能相关。有必要进一步开展专门评估HFmrEF人群的研究。

title: Glucagon-Like Peptide-1 Agonists and the Incidence of Atrial Fibrillation in Obese Patients With Heart Failure With Preserved Ejection Fraction and No Diabetes
summary: Background Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs) reduce cardiovascular risk in obesity, but their effect on atrial fibrillation (AF) in heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF) remains unclear.Methods We analyzed TriNetX data comparing obese, non-diabetic HFpEF patients treated with GLP-1 RAs (n = 478) with untreated patients (n = 6887). Propensity matching yielded 470 patients per cohort.Results GLP-1 RA therapy was not associated with reduced AF incidence (HR 0.86; 95% CI, 0.53-1.39; p = 0.543) but was associated with lower mortality (HR 0.42; 95% CI, 0.23-0.75; p = 0.003).Conclusions GLP-1 RAs may not reduce AF incidence in obese, HFpEF patients.

AI.tldr: 在肥胖、非糖尿病HFpEF患者中，GLP-1受体激动剂未显著降低房颤发生率，但可降低死亡风险。
AI.motivation: GLP-1受体激动剂在肥胖人群中可降低心血管风险，但其对射血分数保留的心力衰竭（HFpEF）患者房颤发生率的影响尚不明确，既往证据有限。
AI.method: 基于TriNetX数据库的回顾性队列研究，纳入肥胖、非糖尿病HFpEF患者，比较接受GLP-1受体激动剂治疗者（n=478）与未治疗者（n=6887），经倾向性匹配后每组470例。主要终点为房颤发生率，次要终点包括死亡等，采用Cox比例风险模型计算风险比（HR）及95%置信区间。
AI.result: GLP-1受体激动剂治疗与房颤发生率降低无显著关联（HR 0.86；95% CI 0.53-1.39；P=0.543），但与死亡率降低显著相关（HR 0.42；95% CI 0.23-0.75；P=0.003）。
AI.conclusion: 在肥胖、非糖尿病HFpEF患者中，GLP-1受体激动剂可能不降低房颤发生率，但可显著降低死亡风险。该结果提示GLP-1受体激动剂对房颤的预防作用有限，临床决策需综合考虑其获益与局限性；本研究为回顾性观察性设计，存在残余混杂可能，需前瞻性研究验证。

summary_zh:
背景：胰高血糖素样肽-1受体激动剂（GLP-1 RAs）可降低肥胖患者的心血管风险，但其对射血分数保留的心力衰竭（HFpEF）患者心房颤动（AF）的影响尚不明确。

方法：我们分析了TriNetX数据，比较接受GLP-1 RAs治疗的肥胖、非糖尿病HFpEF患者（n = 478）与未治疗患者（n = 6887）。倾向性匹配后每组各470例患者。

结果：GLP-1 RA治疗与AF发生率降低无关（HR 0.86；95% CI，0.53-1.39；p = 0.543），但与较低的死亡率相关（HR 0.42；95% CI，0.23-0.75；p = 0.003）。

结论：GLP-1 RAs可能不会降低肥胖HFpEF患者的AF发生率。

title: Efficacy and Safety of 60 W Versus 90 W, 4-s Radiofrequency Applications to the Esophagus-Adjacent Left Atrial Posterior Wall During Pulmonary Vein Isolation: A Pilot Study
summary: Background In very high-power (51-90 W), short-duration (4 s) radiofrequency applications (QMODE+) using the QDOT MICRO catheter, the optimal power setting at the left atrial (LA) posterior wall adjacent to the esophagus for treating atrial fibrillation (AF) remains unclear.Objective We evaluated the efficacy and safety of 60 W versus 90 W QMODE+ radiofrequency applications in the periesophageal region.Methods Fifty AF patients were randomized into two groups based on the QMODE+ power applied to the periesophageal region: 60 W (n = 24) and 90 W (n = 26). We compared the incidence of residual conduction gaps in the periesophageal region and endoscopic esophageal lesions, as well as the 1-year atrial tachyarrhythmia (AT) recurrence rate between the two groups.Results Median contact force was significantly higher in the 60 W group than in the 90 W group (12.9 g [IQR 10.2, 15.8] in the 60 W group and 10.9 g [IQR 8.4, 14.2] in the 90 W group, p < 0.001). The rates of residual conduction gaps (8.3% and 11.5%, respectively, p = 1.00) and esophageal lesions (4.2% in each group) were similar between the two groups. The 1-year AT recurrence rate did not significantly differ between the two groups (20.8% vs. 7.7%, respectively, p = 0.24).Conclusion 60 W and 90 W QMODE+ RF applications for the periesophageal region achieved comparable rates of acute conduction block, endoscopy-detected esophageal injury, and 12-month AT recurrence-free survival, although contact force was significantly higher in the 60 W group.Trial registration Japan Registry of Clinical Trials (jRCT); jRCT1072230115 (Registered on February 8, 2024).

AI.tldr: 在肺静脉隔离中，对邻近食管的左房后壁采用60 W与90 W的QMODE+消融，急性传导阻滞率、内镜食管损伤率及1年房性心律失常复发率均无显著差异。
AI.motivation: 使用QDOT MICRO导管的超高功率短时程（QMODE+，51–90 W、4 s）消融时，邻近食管的左房后壁最佳功率设置尚不明确，需在疗效与食管安全性之间寻找平衡。
AI.method: 单中心随机对照预试验，纳入50例AF患者，按periesophageal区域QMODE+功率随机分为60 W组（n=24）与90 W组（n=26）。比较periesophageal区域残余传导间隙发生率、内镜食管损伤及1年房性心动过速/心律失常（AT）复发率；同时记录接触力等参数。
AI.result: 60 W组中位接触力显著高于90 W组（12.9 g [IQR 10.2–15.8] vs 10.9 g [IQR 8.4–14.2]，p<0.001）。残余传导间隙率（8.3% vs 11.5%，p=1.00）、食管损伤率（两组均4.2%）及1年AT复发率（20.8% vs 7.7%，p=0.24）均无显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 60 W与90 W QMODE+在periesophageal区域消融的急性阻滞、内镜食管损伤及12个月无AT复发生存率相当，但60 W组接触力更高；提示较低功率可能在不增加食管损伤的前提下维持疗效。本研究为小样本预试验，统计效能有限，需更大规模研究验证。

summary_zh:
背景：在使用 QDOT MICRO 导管进行极高功率（51-90 W）、短时程（4 s）射频消融（QMODE+）时，治疗心房颤动（AF）时邻近食管的左心房（LA）后壁的最佳功率设置仍不明确。

目的：我们评估了 60 W 与 90 W QMODE+ 射频消融在食管周围区域的有效性和安全性。

方法：50 例 AF 患者根据应用于食管周围区域的 QMODE+ 功率随机分为两组：60 W 组（n = 24）和 90 W 组（n = 26）。我们比较了两组食管周围区域残留传导间隙的发生率、内镜下食管病变的发生率以及 1 年房性快速性心律失常（AT）的复发率。

结果：60 W 组的中位接触力显著高于 90 W 组（60 W 组为 12.9 g [IQR 10.2, 15.8]，90 W 组为 10.9 g [IQR 8.4, 14.2]，p < 0.001）。两组残留传导间隙的发生率（分别为 8.3% 和 11.5%，p = 1.00）和食管病变的发生率（每组均为 4.2%）相似。两组的 1 年 AT 复发率无显著差异（分别为 20.8% vs. 7.7%，p = 0.24）。

结论：尽管 60 W 组的接触力显著更高，但 60 W 和 90 W QMODE+ 射频消融用于食管周围区域在急性传导阻滞率、内镜检测到的食管损伤率以及 12 个月无 AT 复发生存率方面均相当。

试验注册：日本临床试验注册中心（jRCT）；jRCT1072230115（注册于 2024 年 2 月 8 日）。

title: High-Frequency Low-Tidal Volume Ventilation and Procedural Efficiency in Atrial Fibrillation Catheter Ablation: A Single-Center Retrospective Study
summary: Objectives To compare high-frequency low-tidal volume (HFLTV) ventilation with standard ventilation (SV) regarding procedural efficiency, airway mechanics, and clinical outcomes in atrial fibrillation (AF) catheter ablation.Design Retrospective, observational, nonrandomized cohort study.Setting Electrophysiology laboratory of a single tertiary-care university hospital.Participants There were 160 consecutive eligible adults undergoing first-time AF radiofrequency ablation under general anesthesia between June 2023 and May 2024.Interventions Patients received HFLTV (n = 80; respiratory rate 25-30 breaths/min, tidal volume 3-4 mL/kg, ETCO₂ maintained <50 mmHg) or SV (n = 80; tidal volume 6-8 mL/kg, respiratory rate 10-12 breaths/min) per attending anesthesiologist practice. All received propofol-remifentanil total intravenous anesthesia.Measurements and main results Primary outcomes were total procedure time and radiofrequency ablation time; secondary outcomes were airway pressures, oxygenation, AF recurrence at 1 and 6 months, AF-related hospitalization, and complications. HFLTV was associated with lower median procedure time (110 v 128 minutes; p < .001) and ablation time (23 v 28 minutes; p < .001). Peak (14 v 18 cmH₂O) and minimum (13 v 15 cmH₂O) airway pressures were lower with HFLTV (both p < .001), whereas ETCO₂ and SpO₂ nadir were comparable. Multivariable regression identified HFLTV as an independent predictor of shorter ablation time (nonstandardized β=-5.48 minutes; 95% CI -7.05 to -3.91; p < .001). In exploratory analyses, recurrence at 1 month (7.5% v 15.0%; p = .211) and 6 months (13.8% v 18.8%; p = .520) and 6-month AF-related hospitalization (12.5% v 18.8%; p = .384) were numerically lower with HFLTV but confidence intervals were wide and included no difference.Conclusion In a consecutive cohort including paroxysmal and persistent AF, HFLTV was associated with shorter procedure and ablation times and lower measured airway pressures without compromising gas exchange. Clinical outcome analyses were exploratory and hypothesis-generating, warranting prospective randomized evaluation.

AI.tldr: 在房颤射频消融中，高频低潮气量通气较标准通气缩短手术时间和消融时间，且不损害气体交换，但临床结局差异未达统计学意义。
AI.motivation: 房颤导管消融的效率和安全性可能受通气策略影响，但高频低潮气量通气与标准通气在房颤消融中的比较证据有限，尤其缺乏对手术效率、气道力学和临床结局的综合评估。
AI.method: 单中心回顾性观察性非随机队列研究，纳入2023年6月至2024年5月首次接受全身麻醉下房颤射频消融的连续160例成人患者，按麻醉医师实践分为高频低潮气量通气组（n=80，呼吸频率25-30次/分，潮气量3-4 mL/kg，维持ETCO₂<50 mmHg）和标准通气组（n=80，潮气量6-8 mL/kg，呼吸频率10-12次/分）。主要终点为总手术时间和射频消融时间；次要终点包括气道压力、氧合、1个月和6个月房颤复发、房颤相关住院和并发症。采用多变量回归分析。
AI.result: 高频低潮气量通气组中位手术时间（110 vs 128分钟，p<0.001）和消融时间（23 vs 28分钟，p<0.001）均显著缩短。气道峰压（14 vs 18 cmH₂O）和最低压（13 vs 15 cmH₂O）更低（均p<0.001），而ETCO₂和SpO₂最低值相当。多变量回归显示高频低潮气量通气是消融时间缩短的独立预测因素（非标准化β=-5.48分钟；95% CI -7.05至-3.91；p<0.001）。探索性分析中，1个月复发率（7.5% vs 15.0%；p=0.211）、6个月复发率（13.8% vs 18.8%；p=0.520）和6个月房颤相关住院率（12.5% vs 18.8%；p=0.384）在高频低潮气量通气组数值上更低，但置信区间宽且包括无差异。
AI.conclusion: 在包含阵发性和持续性房颤的连续队列中，高频低潮气量通气与更短的手术和消融时间及更低的气道压力相关，且不损害气体交换。临床结局分析为探索性且假设生成性，需前瞻性随机评估。

summary_zh:
目的：比较高频低潮气量（HFLTV）通气与标准通气（SV）在心房颤动（AF）导管消融中关于手术效率、气道力学和临床结局的差异。

设计：回顾性、观察性、非随机队列研究。

地点：单一三级大学医院的电生理实验室。

参与者：2023年6月至2024年5月期间连续160例符合条件的成人患者，在全身麻醉下接受首次AF射频消融。

干预：根据主治麻醉医师的实践，患者接受HFLTV（n = 80；呼吸频率25-30次/分，潮气量3-4 mL/kg，ETCO₂维持<50 mmHg）或SV（n = 80；潮气量6-8 mL/kg，呼吸频率10-12次/分）。所有患者均接受丙泊酚-瑞芬太尼全静脉麻醉。

测量与主要结果：主要结局为总手术时间和射频消融时间；次要结局为气道压力、氧合、1个月和6个月时AF复发、AF相关住院和并发症。HFLTV与较低的中位手术时间（110 vs 128分钟；p < .001）和消融时间（23 vs 28分钟；p < .001）相关。HFLTV的峰值（14 vs 18 cmH₂O）和最低（13 vs 15 cmH₂O）气道压力较低（均p < .001），而ETCO₂和SpO₂最低值相当。多变量回归确定HFLTV是较短消融时间的独立预测因子（非标准化β=-5.48分钟；95% CI -7.05至-3.91；p < .001）。在探索性分析中，HFLTV的1个月（7.5% vs 15.0%；p = .211）和6个月（13.8% vs 18.8%；p = .520）复发率以及6个月AF相关住院率（12.5% vs 18.8%；p = .384）在数值上较低，但置信区间宽且包括无差异。

结论：在包括阵发性和持续性AF的连续队列中，HFLTV与较短的手术和消融时间以及较低的测量气道压力相关，且不损害气体交换。临床结局分析为探索性和假设生成性，值得前瞻性随机评估。

title: Smoking Habit Change and Atrial Fibrillation Risk in Patients With Diabetes Mellitus: A Nationwide Observational Cohort Study in Korea.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Smoking and diabetes mellitus (DM) are known risk factors for atrial fibrillation (AF), but the impact of smoking habit changes on AF risk in patients with DM remains unclear. We aimed to evaluate the association between smoking habit changes and incident AF in patients with DM.

METHODS: Using the Korean nationwide claims database, we identified patients with DM, defined as fasting glucose ≥ 126 mg/dL or use of antidiabetic medications. Smoking habits were assessed by self-reported questionnaires from two health assessments within a two-year interval, and patients were categorized as never smokers, ex-smokers, quitters, or current smokers. The primary outcome was incident AF.

RESULTS: Among 1,354,907 patients with DM (median follow-up 5.93 years, interquartile range 5.30-6.33; mean age 60.0 years [SD 11.8], 51.0% male), current smokers had a 20% higher risk of AF than never smokers (adjusted hazard ratio [95% confidence interval], 1.20 [1.16-1.24]). While ex-smokers and quitters had lower risks than current smokers, their risk remained elevated relative to never smokers, by 8.5% (1.09 [1.04-1.13]) and 10% (1.10 [1.06-1.15]), respectively. Among patients with new-onset DM or DM duration < 5 years, quitters showed comparable AF risk to that of never smokers (1.06 [0.97-1.15] and 1.04 [0.95-1.13], respectively).

CONCLUSION: Smoking cessation in patients with DM was associated with a lower risk of AF than continued smoking. Especially in new-onset DM, AF risk in quitters approached that of never smokers. Encouraging smoking cessation may be beneficial for preventing new-onset AF in patients with DM.

AI.tldr: 在韩国糖尿病患者中，当前吸烟者房颤风险较从不吸烟者高20%，戒烟者风险低于持续吸烟者但仍高于从不吸烟者；新发糖尿病患者戒烟后房颤风险接近从不吸烟者。
AI.motivation: 吸烟和糖尿病均为房颤已知危险因素，但吸烟习惯改变对糖尿病患者房颤风险的影响尚不明确，本研究旨在评估二者关联。
AI.method: 基于韩国全国医保索赔数据库的观察性队列研究，纳入1,354,907例糖尿病患者（空腹血糖≥126 mg/dL或使用降糖药），通过两年内两次健康评估的自报问卷将吸烟习惯分为从不吸烟、已戒烟、戒烟者和当前吸烟者，主要终点为新发房颤，采用多因素调整Cox回归分析。
AI.result: 中位随访5.93年，当前吸烟者房颤风险较从不吸烟者高20%（aHR 1.20，95%CI 1.16-1.24）；已戒烟者和戒烟者风险分别高8.5%（aHR 1.09，95%CI 1.04-1.13）和10%（aHR 1.10，95%CI 1.06-1.15）；在新发糖尿病或病程<5年患者中，戒烟者房颤风险与从不吸烟者相当（aHR 1.06，95%CI 0.97-1.15；aHR 1.04，95%CI 0.95-1.13）。
AI.conclusion: 糖尿病患者戒烟与房颤风险降低相关，尤其在新发糖尿病中戒烟者风险接近从不吸烟者，鼓励戒烟可能有助于预防糖尿病患者新发房颤；但本研究为观察性设计，吸烟习惯依赖自报问卷，存在残余混杂可能。

summary_zh:
背景：吸烟和糖尿病（DM）是已知的心房颤动（AF）危险因素，但吸烟习惯改变对DM患者AF风险的影响尚不清楚。我们旨在评估DM患者中吸烟习惯改变与新发AF之间的关联。

方法：利用韩国全国理赔数据库，我们识别了DM患者，定义为空腹血糖≥126 mg/dL或使用降糖药物。吸烟习惯通过两次健康评估（间隔两年）的自报问卷进行评估，患者被分类为从不吸烟者、既往吸烟者、戒烟者或当前吸烟者。主要结局为新发AF。

结果：在1,354,907名DM患者中（中位随访5.93年，四分位距5.30-6.33；平均年龄60.0岁[标准差11.8]，51.0%为男性），当前吸烟者的AF风险比从不吸烟者高20%（调整风险比[95%置信区间]，1.20[1.16-1.24]）。虽然既往吸烟者和戒烟者的风险低于当前吸烟者，但其风险相对于从不吸烟者仍分别升高8.5%（1.09[1.04-1.13]）和10%（1.10[1.06-1.15]）。在新发DM或DM病程<5年的患者中，戒烟者的AF风险与从不吸烟者相当（分别为1.06[0.97-1.15]和1.04[0.95-1.13]）。

结论：DM患者戒烟与持续吸烟相比，AF风险较低。特别是在新发DM中，戒烟者的AF风险接近从不吸烟者。鼓励戒烟可能有助于预防DM患者的新发AF。

title: Atrial fibrillation is associated with low occupational physical activity and long occupational sedentary time: A national multicenter hospital-based case-control study.
summary:
OBJECTIVE: We examined associations of occupation, industry, occupational physical activity (OPA), and occupational sedentary time (OST) with atrial fibrillation (AF).

METHODS: We conducted a national hospital-based case-control study in Japan. AF cases (N=7,013), identified using ICD-10 codes I47/I48 and catheter ablation (ICD-9-CM 37.34), were matched 1:1 to controls by sex, age, admission year, and hospital. OPA was classified from the longest-held occupation and OST using an occupation-by-industry job-exposure matrix.

RESULTS: Some manual occupations and service/construction industries had lower AF odds. Moderate/low OPA had higher odds than high OPA (OR 1.34, 95% CI 1.19-1.50; 1.46, 1.30-1.63), and intermediate/long OST than short OST (1.21, 1.11-1.32; 1.15, 1.06-1.24).

CONCLUSIONS: Lower OPA and longer OST were associated with higher AF odds. Occupation-related activity may inform prevention targeting prolonged sitting and low physical activity.

AI.tldr: 日本全国多中心病例对照研究显示，中低职业体力活动与较长职业久坐时间均与房颤风险升高相关（OR 1.34-1.46及1.15-1.21）。
AI.motivation: 职业相关的体力活动与久坐时间对房颤风险的影响尚不明确，既往研究多关注休闲时间体力活动，缺乏职业暴露与房颤关联的大样本证据。
AI.method: 日本全国多中心医院病例对照研究，纳入房颤病例7013例（ICD-10编码I47/I48且接受导管消融ICD-9-CM 37.34），按性别、年龄、入院年份和医院1:1匹配对照。职业体力活动（OPA）根据最长从事职业分类，职业久坐时间（OST）采用职业-行业暴露矩阵评估。主要终点为房颤与OPA及OST的关联，采用条件logistic回归计算OR及95%CI。
AI.result: 部分体力劳动职业及服务/建筑行业与房颤风险降低相关。与高OPA相比，中/低OPA的OR分别为1.34（95%CI 1.19-1.50）和1.46（1.30-1.63）；与短OST相比，中/长OST的OR分别为1.21（1.11-1.32）和1.15（1.06-1.24）。
AI.conclusion: 较低职业体力活动和较长职业久坐时间与房颤风险升高独立相关，提示针对职业性久坐和低体力活动的干预可能有助于房颤预防。但作为病例对照研究，不能推断因果关系，且OPA和OST基于职业矩阵评估可能存在暴露错分。

summary_zh:
目的：我们研究了职业、行业、职业体力活动（OPA）和职业久坐时间（OST）与心房颤动（AF）的关联。

方法：我们在日本开展了一项全国性医院为基础的病例对照研究。AF病例（N=7,013）通过ICD-10编码I47/I48和导管消融术（ICD-9-CM 37.34）识别，并按性别、年龄、入院年份和医院与对照1:1匹配。OPA根据最长从事的职业进行分类，OST使用职业-行业工作暴露矩阵进行评估。

结果：一些体力职业和服务/建筑行业的AF比值比较低。中等/低OPA的比值比高于高OPA（OR 1.34，95% CI 1.19-1.50；1.46，1.30-1.63），中等/长OST的比值比高于短OST（1.21，1.11-1.32；1.15，1.06-1.24）。

结论：较低的OPA和较长的OST与较高的AF比值比相关。职业相关活动可能为针对久坐和低体力活动的预防提供信息。

title: In Silico Study of Digitoxin from Foxglove (Digitalis purpurea L.) on Beta-1 Adrenergic Receptors in Heart Failure and Atrial Fibrillation
summary: Atrial fibrillation and heart failure are highly morbid and mortal cardiovascular diseases worldwide. Beta-1 adrenergic receptors are the mediators of cardiac function and the primary therapeutic targets in both diseases. Digitalis purpurea L., popularly known as foxglove or thimble flower is a medicinal herb used traditionally to cure heart disease and contains a cardiac glycoside alkaloid compound, digitoxin. This study aims to investigate in silico the potential interaction of digitoxin with beta-1 adrenergic receptors as a drug lead for heart failure and atrial fibrillation treatment. Bioactive compounds of Digitalis purpurea were systematically evaluated for their physicochemical properties according to Lipinski’s Rule of Five (RO5), pharmacokinetic profiles via ADMET prediction, pharmacophore features using LigandScout, and molecular interactions through molecular docking employing AutoDock 4.2.6. Results demonstrated that digitoxin has best oral bioavailability and intensively binds beta-1 adrenergic receptors with a Gibbs free energy of -9.24 kcal/mol, where hydrogen and hydrophobic interactions between digitoxin and receptor active site residues form. All of these show that digitoxin may be able to be developed as a heart failure and atrial fibrillation natural-based drug.

AI.tldr: 分子对接显示洋地黄毒苷与β1肾上腺素能受体结合自由能为-9.24 kcal/mol，提示其或可成为心衰与房颤的天然药物先导。
AI.motivation: 房颤与心衰是全球高发病率和高死亡率的心血管疾病，β1肾上腺素能受体是两者共同的关键治疗靶点。洋地黄毒苷是毛地黄中的强心苷类生物碱，传统用于心脏病，但其与β1受体的分子相互作用尚不明确，本研究旨在通过计算机模拟评估其作为心衰和房颤治疗药物先导的潜力。
AI.method: 本研究为计算机模拟（in silico）研究，未涉及人体或动物样本。系统评估毛地黄生物活性成分的理化性质（Lipinski五规则）、药代动力学特征（ADMET预测）、药效团特征（LigandScout）及分子相互作用（AutoDock 4.2.6分子对接）。主要终点为洋地黄毒苷与β1肾上腺素能受体的结合自由能及相互作用模式。
AI.result: 洋地黄毒苷表现出最佳的口服生物利用度，并与β1肾上腺素能受体活性位点残基形成氢键和疏水相互作用，结合自由能为-9.24 kcal/mol。摘要未报告其他化合物的具体对接数据、置信区间或P值。
AI.conclusion: 计算机模拟结果提示洋地黄毒苷可能作为心衰和房颤的天然药物先导，但本研究仅为计算预测，缺乏实验验证和临床数据，其临床意义需进一步体外和体内研究证实。

summary_zh: 心房颤动和心力衰竭是全球范围内高发病率和高死亡率的心血管疾病。β1肾上腺素能受体是心脏功能的介质，也是这两种疾病的主要治疗靶点。Digitalis purpurea L.，俗称毛地黄或指顶花，是一种传统上用于治疗心脏病的药用草本植物，含有一种强心苷生物碱化合物——洋地黄毒苷。本研究旨在通过计算机模拟研究洋地黄毒苷与β1肾上腺素能受体的潜在相互作用，作为治疗心力衰竭和心房颤动的先导药物。根据Lipinski五规则（RO5）系统评估了Digitalis purpurea的生物活性化合物的理化性质，通过ADMET预测评估药代动力学特征，使用LigandScout评估药效团特征，并通过AutoDock 4.2.6进行分子对接评估分子相互作用。结果表明，洋地黄毒苷具有最佳的口服生物利用度，并以-9.24 kcal/mol的吉布斯自由能与β1肾上腺素能受体强烈结合，其中洋地黄毒苷与受体活性位点残基之间形成氢键和疏水相互作用。所有这些表明，洋地黄毒苷可能被开发为一种基于天然产物的心力衰竭和心房颤动药物。

title: Evolution of Radiofrequency Transseptal Puncture Devices
summary: Transseptal puncture (TSP) is an indispensable step for establishing left atrial access and plays a pivotal role in complex left-heart interventions, including catheter ablation for atrial fibrillation, left atrial appendage occlusion, and transcatheter mitral valve therapy. As such, TSP ranks among the core techniques in contemporary cardiovascular interventional cardiology. Since its first description in the 1950s, TSP tools have undergone decades of iterative refinement, evolving from conventional mechanical needles to diverse energy-assisted puncture systems. The performance of a TSP system directly determines procedural success, safety, and patient prognosis. This article systematically reviews the developmental history of TSP devices, with a focused overview of the developmental background, technical evolution, clinical applications, and advantages of radiofrequency-based puncture devices (including radiofrequency guidewires and radiofrequency needles), and briefly outlines future directions for innovation.

AI.tldr: 本文系统回顾房间隔穿刺器械的发展，重点介绍射频导丝和射频针等射频辅助穿刺装置的技术演变与临床应用优势。
AI.motivation: 房间隔穿刺是房颤消融、左心耳封堵及经导管二尖瓣治疗等左心介入的必备步骤，但传统机械穿刺针依赖术者经验，存在穿刺失败和并发症风险，既往文献对射频辅助穿刺器械的系统梳理有限。
AI.method: 本文为叙述性综述，系统回顾房间隔穿刺器械的发展历史，重点概述射频辅助穿刺装置（包括射频导丝和射频针）的开发背景、技术演变、临床应用及优势，并简要展望未来创新方向；摘要未报告具体研究人群、样本量、终点定义或统计方法。
AI.result: 摘要未报告定量数据、效应量、95%置信区间或P值；仅定性指出房间隔穿刺系统性能直接决定手术成功率、安全性和患者预后，射频辅助穿刺装置在技术演变中展现出相应优势。
AI.conclusion: 射频辅助房间隔穿刺器械是房间隔穿刺技术的重要演进方向，可能提升复杂左心介入中房间隔穿刺的成功率与安全性；但本文为综述，缺乏原始临床数据，其对电生理实践的具体影响尚需对照研究验证。

summary_zh: 房间隔穿刺（transseptal puncture，TSP）是建立左心房入路不可或缺的步骤，在复杂左心介入手术中发挥关键作用，包括心房颤动的导管消融、左心耳封堵以及经导管二尖瓣治疗。因此，TSP 位列当代心血管介入心脏病学的核心技术之一。自 20 世纪 50 年代首次描述以来，TSP 工具经历了数十年的迭代改进，从传统机械穿刺针发展为多种能量辅助穿刺系统。TSP 系统的性能直接决定手术成功率、安全性及患者预后。本文系统综述 TSP 器械的发展历史，重点概述射频穿刺器械（包括射频导丝和射频穿刺针）的发展背景、技术演进、临床应用及优势，并简要展望未来的创新方向。

title: Pulmonary Vein Isolation with Different Single-Shot Ablation Devices in Patients with Atrial Fibrillation: A Prospective Observational Single-Center Clinical Evaluation
summary: Background and Objectives: The conventional technique for atrial fibrillation (AF) ablation has gradually been supplemented by ‘single-shot’ devices. Comparisons of devices using three different energy sources are rare. We aimed to evaluate the outcomes of patients with AF who underwent pulmonary vein isolation (PVI) using three various single-shot ablation techniques. We also examined factors associated with arrhythmia recurrence during the 12-month follow-up. Materials and Methods: We prospectively analyzed single-center data from consecutive adult patients undergoing PVI with different single-shot devices between January and December 2024. For cryoablation, a second-generation cryoballoon (AFA, Medtronic, Minneapolis, MN, USA) was used; for radiofrequency balloon ablation, the RFB catheter (Heliostar, Biosense Webster, California, CA, USA) was applied; and for the PFA-guided procedure, the Farawave (Boston Scientific, Massachusetts, MA, USA) ablation catheter was used. The procedural endpoint was to achieve intraoperative PVI. Arrhythmia recurrence was defined as any episode lasting >30 s documented by electrocardiographic recordings. Results: Ultimately, the analysis included 115 patients. Of these, 41 underwent PVI by cryoablation, 22 underwent RFB therapy, and 52 underwent PFA. The total skin-to-skin procedure time was the shortest among PFA-patients, primarily due to shorter left atrial dwell time. After 12 months of follow-up, 30 patients experienced recurrence of atrial arrhythmia. A larger left atrium diameter increased the risk of arrhythmia recurrence, whereas propafenone therapy at discharge was associated with a lower risk of recurrence during the 12-month follow-up. Conclusions: In this single-center observational study, PVI performed with PFA was associated with the shortest procedure time compared with procedures using CBA or RFB, with no difference in the risk of arrhythmia recurrence among the single-shot ablation modalities during the 12-month follow-up.

title: Real-World Experience With the Extravascular Implantable Cardioverter Defibrillator Through 1 Year: The Enlighten Post Approval Registry Study.
summary:
BACKGROUND: The extravascular implantable cardioverter defibrillator (EV-ICD) was developed to provide defibrillation and antitachycardia pacing therapy without the need for intravascular lead placement. Premarket clinical trials reported EV-ICD safety and efficacy through 3 years, but a real-world assessment of the Aurora EV-ICD system, which includes a novel sensing discriminator, is needed. The objective of this analysis was to assess real-world therapy efficacy and safety of the EV-ICD through 1 year.

METHODS: Enlighten: The EV-ICD Post Approval Registry is a prospective, global, real-world registry that included patients who underwent an EV-ICD implantation attempt. The main safety analysis was freedom from all system- or procedure-related major complications through 1 year. Event rates at 1 year were calculated using the Kaplan-Meier method.

RESULTS: EV-ICD system implantation was attempted by 168 implanters in 787 patients (49.1±15.2 years old; 28.7% women; 34.1% secondary prevention). Tunneling and lead placement in the substernal space were achieved in 781 of 787 patients (99.2%), with 758 patients (96.3%) remaining implanted following defibrillation and electrical testing. One-year freedom from major system- or procedure-related complications was 89.1% (95% CI, 86.3%-91.3%). The 1-year rate of first appropriate therapy (shock, antitachycardia pacing, or both) was 7.3% (95% CI, 5.5-9.6). Shock success for discrete spontaneous episodes was 100% (61 of 61), and the generalized estimating equations antitachycardia pacing success rate, to account for multiple episodes per patient, was 74.2% for monomorphic ventricular tachycardia. The 1-year rate of first inappropriate shock was 7.1% (95% CI, 5.4-9.4), with noncardiac oversensing as the main cause (40.5% of inappropriately shocked episodes).

CONCLUSIONS: In the largest prospective worldwide cohort of patients with an EV-ICD to date, both antitachycardia pacing and shock therapy were effective, while the rate of major complications agreed with the premarket experience through 1 year. These data demonstrate that positive outcomes of the EV-ICD are retained in everyday clinical practice in a large, global cohort with an expanded number of implanters.

AI.motivation: EV-ICD旨在无需血管内导线即可提供除颤和抗心动过速起搏治疗，上市前试验已报告3年安全性和有效性，但缺乏对包含新型感知鉴别器的Aurora EV-ICD系统的真实世界评估。
AI.method: Enlighten注册研究为前瞻性、全球、真实世界注册研究，纳入787例尝试EV-ICD植入的患者（年龄49.1±15.2岁，女性28.7%，34.1%为二级预防），主要安全终点为1年内无系统或操作相关主要并发症，采用Kaplan-Meier法计算事件率。
AI.result: 781/787例（99.2%）成功完成胸骨下隧道和导线放置，758例（96.3%）在除颤和电学测试后保持植入。1年无主要并发症率为89.1%（95%CI 86.3%-91.3%）。首次恰当治疗（电击、ATP或两者）1年率为7.3%（95%CI 5.5-9.6）。自发性离散事件电击成功率为100%（61/61），单形性室速的ATP成功率（GEE模型）为74.2%。首次不恰当电击1年率为7.1%（95%CI 5.4-9.4），主要原因为非心脏过感知（占不恰当电击事件的40.5%）。
AI.conclusion: 在迄今最大的全球EV-ICD前瞻性队列中，ATP和电击治疗均有效，主要并发症率与上市前经验一致，表明EV-ICD的良好结局在扩大植入者数量的真实临床实践中得以保持。

summary_zh:
背景：血管外植入式心律转复除颤器（EV-ICD）的研发旨在提供除颤和抗心动过速起搏治疗，而无需血管内导线放置。上市前临床试验报告了EV-ICD 3年的安全性和有效性，但需要对包含新型感知鉴别器的Aurora EV-ICD系统进行真实世界评估。本分析的目的是评估EV-ICD在1年内的真实世界治疗有效性和安全性。

方法：Enlighten：EV-ICD上市后注册研究是一项前瞻性、全球性、真实世界注册研究，纳入尝试进行EV-ICD植入的患者。主要安全性分析为1年内无所有系统或操作相关重大并发症。1年事件率采用Kaplan-Meier法计算。

结果：168名植入者尝试对787例患者（年龄49.1±15.2岁；女性28.7%；34.1%为二级预防）进行EV-ICD系统植入。781/787例患者（99.2%）成功完成胸骨下间隙的隧道建立和导线放置，758例患者（96.3%）在除颤和电学测试后仍保持植入。1年无重大系统或操作相关并发症率为89.1%（95% CI，86.3%-91.3%）。首次恰当治疗（电击、抗心动过速起搏或两者兼有）的1年发生率为7.3%（95% CI，5.5-9.6）。针对离散自发性发作的电击成功率为100%（61/61），采用广义估计方程计算的抗心动过速起搏成功率（以考虑每位患者多次发作）在单形性室性心动过速中为74.2%。首次不恰当电击的1年发生率为7.1%（95% CI，5.4-9.4），主要原因为非心脏性过感知（占不恰当电击发作的40.5%）。

结论：在迄今为止最大的全球EV-ICD前瞻性患者队列中，抗心动过速起搏和电击治疗均有效，而重大并发症发生率与上市前经验在1年内一致。这些数据表明，EV-ICD的积极结果在植入者数量扩大的大型全球队列的日常临床实践中得以保持。
