title: Small but lethal: cystic tumour of the atrioventricular node-a case report
summary: Background Cystic tumours of the AV node (CTAVN) are exceptionally uncommon congenital cardiac tuours, with an incidence of 0.0017-0.03%.Case summary A 47-year-old woman with recurrent symptomatic tachycardia underwent an ablation. Coronary sinus was noted to be enlarged. Subsequent cardiac CT revelead a well-circumscribed cystic lesioni in the Triangle of Koch, suspicious of a CTAVN. Multimodal imaging, including echocardiography, coronary angiography and cardiac MRI confirmed a non-vascular, encapsulated lesion with imaging characteristics consistent with a benign cystic mass. Given the risk of sudden cardiac death, surgical resection was performed. Histopathology confirmed CTAVN. The postoperative course as complicated by complete heart block requiring pacemaker implantation, with no recurrence at one year.Discussion CTAVN is a rare but clinically significant benign tumour associated with conduction abnormalities and malignant arrhythmias. This care highlights the importance of multimodal imaging in diagnosis and the role of early surgical intervention to mitigate life-threatening complications.

title: Cathepsin C promotes atherosclerosis by modulating neutrophil recruitment and neutrophil extracellular trap formation
summary: Atherosclerotic plaque instability is a critical determinant of sudden cardiac death (SCD). While Cathepsin C (CTSC) participates in inflammatory diseases, its functional contribution and cellular origin in atherosclerosis remain incompletely understood. This study investigates whether CTSC derived from foam cells modulates neutrophil behavior to exacerbate plaque progression. We analyzed human coronary arteries from control, coronary heart disease (CHD), and SCD cohorts. An ApoE-/- mouse model of atherosclerosis with AAV-mediated CTSC knockdown was established. Cellular experiments involved co-culture of THP-1-derived foam cells with differentiated HL-60 neutrophils, employing the CTSC inhibitor AZD7986 for mechanistic studies. We found that CTSC and neutrophil extracellular trap (NETs) markers were significantly elevated in human and mouse plaques and were particularly increased in SCD specimens. Silencing CTSC in mice markedly attenuated plaque development and NETS formation. Mechanistically, foam cell-secreted CTSC promoted neutrophil migration by activating the PR3/IL-1β/NF-κB signaling cascade. Simultaneously, CTSC triggered NETosis through a separate p38 MAPK/ROS-dependent pathway. Notably, the resulting NETs enhanced lipid accumulation in foam cells, creating a pathogenic feedback cycle. Our findings identify CTSC as an important regulator of neutrophil recruitment and NETosis in atherosclerosis and suggest its potential as a therapeutic target for plaque stabilization. Our findings identify CTSC as an important regulator of neutrophil recruitment and NETosis in atherosclerosis and suggest its potential as a therapeutic target for modulating atherosclerotic plaque pathology.

title: Preemptive mechanical circulatory support in ventricular tachycardia ablation: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
summary:
BACKGROUND: The benefit of preemptive mechanical circulatory support (MCS) for ventricular tachycardia (VT) ablation remains unclear. This meta-analysis compared the efficacy and safety of preemptive MCS to standard care for VT ablation.

METHODS: An unrestricted literature search of PubMed, Embase, and Web of Science identified studies on preemptive MCS for VT ablation. MCS included percutaneous left ventricular assist devices or extracorporeal membrane oxygenation. The primary endpoint was all-cause mortality; secondary endpoints included VT recurrence, procedural time, procedural complications (vascular access, bleeding, stroke, pericardial effusion, heart failure, myocardial infarction), and 30-day major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE).

RESULTS: Eight studies with 2,262 patients (414 with MCS, 1,848 without) were included. Mean follow-up was 15.8 months, mean age was 62.6 years, 12.5% were women, and mean PAINESD scores were 15.7 in the MCS group and 10.5 in the no-MCS group. There was no significant difference in all-cause mortality (OR 1.58, 95% CI 0.60-4.19, p = 0.36, I²=81%) or VT recurrence (OR 1.03, 95% CI 0.68-1.56, p = 0.90, I²=46%). Preemptive MCS was associated with longer procedural times (mean difference 46.0 min, 95% CI 11.1-80.8, p = 0.01, I²=86%), more procedural complications-driven by vascular access and pericardial effusion (OR 2.25, 95% CI 1.26-4.03, p = 0.006, I²=33%). Thirty-day MACE was not uniformly defined across studies and was therefore not pooled.

CONCLUSIONS: Preemptive MCS was not associated with a significant difference in all-cause mortality or VT recurrence in patients undergoing VT ablation but was associated with longer procedures, and more procedural complications. The certainty of evidence was very low, reflecting the observational study design, baseline imbalance between groups, and heterogeneity; these findings do not preclude the selective use of MCS in high-risk patients and require confirmation in randomized trials.

AI.method: 系统综述与荟萃分析，检索PubMed、Embase和Web of Science，纳入8项研究共2262例患者（MCS组414例，无MCS组1848例）。MCS包括经皮左心室辅助装置或体外膜肺氧合。主要终点为全因死亡率；次要终点包括VT复发、手术时间、手术并发症（血管入路、出血、卒中、心包积液、心力衰竭、心肌梗死）和30天主要不良心血管事件（MACE）。

背景：预防性机械循环支持（MCS）用于室性心动过速（VT）消融的获益仍不明确。本荟萃分析比较了预防性MCS与标准治疗在VT消融中的疗效与安全性。

title: Incidence of refibrillation and shock-resistant ventricular fibrillation during OHCA when treated with a public access defibrillator: implications for CPR timing in lay rescuer-treated OHCA.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Out-of-hospital cardiac arrest (OHCA) treatment often requires multiple defibrillatory shocks due to failed defibrillation or refibrillation. The complete nature of refractory ventricular fibrillation (VF) is unknown, as many studies do not consider shocks delivered by lay rescuers prior to the arrival of basic life support (BLS)/advanced life support (ALS) when quantifying refractory VF. ERC guidelines define refractory VF as continuous VF after three consecutive shocks, not differentiating between patients who refibrillate and those with shock-resistant VF (three consecutive failed shocks) which may contribute to this variation in reported incidence. There are some differences in treatment recommendations for patients who refibrillate and those with shock-resistant VF. Therefore, understanding the number of shocks delivered by lay-rescuers with public access defibrillators (PADs) and the patient's response to them prior to BLS/ALS arrival may inform treatment strategies.

METHODS: ECG data collected retrospectively from OHCAs treated by lay-rescuers using PADs were analysed. Cardiac rhythm, shock success, refibrillation, time to refibrillation and presence of shock-resistant VF (three consecutive failed shocks) were determined by two investigators.

RESULTS: Data were available for 1459 patients receiving at least one shock. Refibrillation occurred in 498 (34.1%) patients. The median number of refibrillations per patient was 1 (IQR 1, 2). Median time to refibrillation was 29.8 s. Three consecutive shocks were observed in 231 of the 1459 (15.8%) patients, 11 patients (4.8% of 231 patients) had shock-resistant VF.

CONCLUSION: When treated by lay-rescuers with PADs, refibrillation occurrence is lower than that reported for patients treated by BLS/ALS. However, aligned with BLS/ALS studies, in lay-rescuer treated OHCA, refibrillation typically occurs within the first 30 s following a successful shock. Therefore, patients who refibrillate are typically in VF for an additional 1.5 min before receiving a subsequent shock for PADs with a 2 min cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) cycle. This finding emphasises the need for investigation into optimal CPR duration for patients requiring multiple shocks.

summary_zh:
背景：院外心脏骤停（OHCA）的治疗常因除颤失败或再次颤动而需要多次除颤电击。难治性心室颤动（VF）的完整特征尚不清楚，因为许多研究在量化难治性VF时未考虑在基础生命支持（BLS）/高级生命支持（ALS）到达之前由非专业施救者实施的除颤电击。ERC指南将难治性VF定义为连续三次电击后仍持续存在的VF，未区分再次颤动患者与电击抵抗性VF（连续三次电击失败）患者，这可能导致了报道发生率的不同。对于再次颤动患者和电击抵抗性VF患者的治疗建议存在一些差异。因此，了解非专业施救者使用公共除颤器（PAD）实施的电击次数以及患者在BLS/ALS到达前的反应，可能有助于制定治疗策略。

方法：回顾性分析由非专业施救者使用PAD治疗的OHCA患者的心电图数据。由两名研究者确定心律、电击成功、再次颤动、再次颤动时间以及电击抵抗性VF（连续三次电击失败）的存在。

结果：可获得1459例至少接受一次电击的患者数据。498例（34.1%）患者发生再次颤动。每位患者再次颤动次数的中位数为1次（IQR 1，2）。再次颤动的中位时间为29.8秒。在1459例患者中，231例（15.8%）观察到连续三次电击，其中11例（占231例患者的4.8%）存在电击抵抗性VF。

结论：当由非专业施救者使用PAD治疗时，再次颤动的发生率低于BLS/ALS治疗患者的报道。然而，与BLS/ALS研究一致，在非专业施救者治疗的OHCA中，再次颤动通常发生在成功电击后的前30秒内。因此，对于采用2分钟心肺复苏（CPR）周期的PAD，再次颤动的患者在接受后续电击前通常额外处于VF状态1.5分钟。这一发现强调需要研究需要多次电击患者的最佳CPR持续时间。

title: The impact of early pre-hospital ventricular tachycardia/fibrillation detected by TTECG on in-hospital mortality on patients with ST segment elevation myocardial infarction treated with primary percutaneous coronary intervention
summary: our findings indicate that a previously published higher in-hospital survival rate of STEMI patients elicited by TTECG-based consultation [8] may be associated with better coronary flow in response to an improved pre-hospital medical therapy. According to our data: 1) an early, TTECG-facilitated diagnosis of STEMI and a triage of patients and 2) optimal pre-hospital antithrombotic therapy (administration of ASA and/or clopidogrel and GP IIb/IIIa inhibitor) are important predictors of a lower in-hospital mortality rate (i.e. higher survival rate). On the other hand, age, AHF and pre-hospital VT/VF were the most important independent predictors of an increased risk of hospital mortality.

title: The Impact of Tamoxifen on Cardiac Electrophysiology in the Context of the Tamoxifen-Inducible Cre-Loxp System in Mice
summary: Sudden cardiac death is one of the leading causes of death worldwide, with lethal ventricular arrhythmias being likely responsible for most incidents. The frequency of sudden cardiac death is increasing, presenting the need for more research into the causes and treatments of these deadly arrhythmias. As arrhythmia research increases to meet the need for more effective treatments, there is a distinct need for increased scrutiny into the possible confounding variables present in current models of arrhythmogenic disease. One of the most common and effective models for arrhythmia research is mice, utilizing the tamoxifen-inducible cardiac specific Cre-loxp system. In this system, tamoxifen is used to activate the Cre recombinase protein, made to express only in the heart. This protein targets and removes two inserted artificial loxp sites and the sequence between them, resulting in a gene knockout or other manipulation. This system can be used to target specific proteins known to contribute to arrhythmia formation, while avoiding developmental complications common in constitutive knockouts of cardiac proteins. The cardiac-specific Cre-loxp system is known to have off-target effects, including inflammation, fibrosis, and reduced cardiac performance. Tamoxifen also has effects on cardiac electrophysiology, with the ability to block sodium channels, which can slow conduction and promote arrhythmias. As many studies focus on tamoxifen in the context of its use in human patients, it is unknown whether tamoxifen on its own, as used in the mouse Cre-loxp system, can create an arrhythmogenic phenotype. We conducted studies to determine how tamoxifen impacts cardiac electrophysiology and the expression of key proteins responsible for conduction in an ex vivio mouse model. We found that tamoxifen could slow conduction, and change action potential duration characteristics, particularly at shorter paced cycle lengths. This indicates that tamoxifen can interfere with cardiac electrophysiology, and that these effects need to be controlled for in arrhythmia research using models which are exposed to tamoxifen.

title: Subcutaneous and Extravascular Implantable Cardioverter-Defibrillators: A Clinical Framework for Breast Surgery, Pregnancy, Lactation, Radiation Therapy, and Breast Imaging
summary: The subcutaneous implantable cardioverter-defibrillator and extravascular implantable cardioverter-defibrillator do not require intravascular, intracardiac, or epicardial leads, making them attractive alternatives to transvenous implantable cardioverter defibrillators in patients without bradycardia pacing or cardiac resynchronization therapy indications. These systems are especially useful for patients with venous access challenges and those at risk for endovascular infections, including patients with renal failure or those who are immunocompromised. Women with prior or anticipated breast surgery, such as mastectomy or breast reconstruction surgery, or those who are lactating present unique anatomic, procedural, and post-operative quality-of-life considerations. This commentary provides a practical, scenario-based framework for managing this unique patient group. Key considerations include individualized incision and pulse generator planning, proactive multidisciplinary coordination, procedure-specific management, and shared decision-making in patients with prior or anticipated breast augmentation or reduction, pregnancy, lactation, mastectomy, radiation therapy, and breast imaging.

title: Permanent pacemaker implantation after sutureless aortic valve replacement with the perceval valve: predictors and clinical implications.
summary:
OBJECTIVES: Permanent pacemaker implantation (PPI) remains a concern after sutureless aortic valve replacement (S-AVR) with the Perceval valve. This study aimed to identify preoperative predictors of PPI and evaluate its impact on mid-term survival in a large single-center cohort.

METHODS: We retrospectively analyzed 334 patients who underwent S-AVR using the Perceval valve between January 2017 and December 2023. Patients were stratified according to the occurrence of postoperative PPI. Independent predictors of PPI were identified using multivariable logistic regression. Overall survival was assessed using Kaplan-Meier analysis and Cox proportional hazards modeling.

RESULTS: PPI occurred in 21 patients (6.2%). Preoperative right bundle branch block (RBBB) was significantly more prevalent among patients requiring PPI (66.7% vs. 11.2%, P < 0.001). In multivariable logistic regression analysis, preoperative RBBB (Odds ratio [OR] 44.42; P < 0.001), hypertension, and QRS duration (per 10-ms increase) were independently associated with PPI. The association between RBBB and PPI remained significant in Firth penalized logistic regression analysis (OR, 32.77; P < 0.001).

CONCLUSIONS: Preoperative RBBB is independently associated with PPI after Perceval S-AVR and demonstrated the strongest observed association among the evaluated variables. Careful preoperative risk stratification and postoperative rhythm surveillance may help identify patients at increased risk for conduction-related complications.

title: Identifying sleep profiles in patients with an implantable cardioverter-defibrillator: associations with psychological distress.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Sleep disturbances are highly prevalent and associated with greater psychological symptom burden in patients with implantable cardioverter-defibrillators (ICDs), yet the multidimensional nature of sleep disturbance in this population remains insufficiently characterized.

OBJECTIVES: This study aimed to (1) identify distinct sleep patterns in patients with an ICD using the seven Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index (PSQI) component scores, (2) examine sociodemographic and clinical predictors of sleep-profile membership, and (3) assess associations between sleep profiles and symptom burden of posttraumatic stress, anxiety, and depression.

METHODS: Sleep profiles were derived from PSQI component scores using latent profile analysis (LPA). Sociodemographic and clinical determinants of profile membership were evaluated using multinomial logistic regression. Associations between sleep profiles and posttraumatic stress, anxiety, and depression symptom severity were examined using linear regression, assessed using the Posttraumatic Diagnostic Scale (PDS), Generalized Anxiety Disorder-7 (GAD-7), and Patient Health Questionnaire-8 (PHQ-8).

RESULTS: Four sleep profiles were identified: Best sleep (mean 35.9%), Intermediate sleep (mean 38.2%), Worst sleep (mean 13.1%), and Medicated sleep (mean 12.8%) of participants across imputed datasets. Compared with the Best sleep profile, all other profiles exhibited significantly higher PDS, GAD-7, and PHQ-8 scores. Sociodemographic and clinical variables were not associated with sleep-profile membership in multinomial models.

CONCLUSIONS: ICD patients demonstrate heterogeneous subjective sleep profiles that are differentially associated with posttraumatic stress, anxiety, and depression symptom severity. These findings highlight the relevance of considering multiple dimensions of subjective sleep disturbance in ICD patients and may help characterize patients at elevated risk for psychological symptoms.

title: Epicardial Use of Medtronic 3830 Lead in Pediatric Cardiac Resynchronization Therapy with Elevated Thresholds.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Epicardial pacing is standard in children, but conventional leads often fail due to high thresholds, fractures, or poor sensing after multiple surgeries.

CASE: A 10-year-old with restrictive cardiomyopathy and prior mitral valve replacement presented with loss of capture from fractured epicardial leads. Redo sternotomy attempts with conventional leads produced thresholds up to 8.0 V. A Medtronic SelectSecure 3830 lead was implanted epicardially, achieving improved thresholds (2.7 V → 1.1 V) and stable cardiac resynchronization therapy (CRT) pacemaker function. At 2 months, thresholds and impedances remained low and stable.

CONCLUSION: Epicardial Medtronic SelectSecure 3830 lead implantation may be a feasible alternative in complex pediatric redo cases.

AI.tldr: 1例10岁限制型心肌病患儿经心外膜植入Medtronic 3830起搏导线，阈值由2.7 V降至1.1 V并维持稳定CRT起搏，提示该导线可作为复杂儿童再手术病例的替代选择。
AI.motivation: 儿童起搏以心外膜途径为标准，但传统心外膜导线在多次手术后易出现高阈值、导线断裂或感知不良，导致起搏失夺获；此类复杂再手术病例缺乏可靠导线选择，既往证据有限。
AI.method: 单例病例报告。对象为10岁限制型心肌病、既往二尖瓣置换术后患儿，因心外膜导线断裂致夺获丧失。再次胸骨正中切开尝试传统导线，起搏阈值高达8.0 V。改用心外膜植入Medtronic SelectSecure 3830导线，评估起搏阈值、阻抗及CRT起搏功能，随访2个月。
AI.result: 3830导线心外膜植入后起搏阈值由2.7 V降至1.1 V，CRT起搏器功能稳定；随访2个月时阈值与阻抗均保持低值且稳定。摘要未报告阻抗具体数值、感知参数及P值等统计结果。
AI.conclusion: 心外膜植入Medtronic SelectSecure 3830导线在复杂儿童再手术病例中可行，可获得低而稳定的起搏阈值并维持CRT。但证据仅来自单例、随访仅2个月，长期导线稳定性与疗效尚需更大样本和更长随访验证，暂不能推广为标准策略。

背景：心外膜起搏在儿童中是标准做法，但传统导线常因高阈值、断裂或多次手术后感知不良而失败。

病例：一名10岁患有限制型心肌病且既往行二尖瓣置换术的患儿，因心外膜导线断裂导致夺获丧失就诊。使用传统导线再次胸骨切开尝试产生的阈值高达8.0 V。植入Medtronic SelectSecure 3830导线于心外膜，实现了阈值改善（2.7 V → 1.1 V）和稳定的心脏再同步治疗（CRT）起搏器功能。2个月时，阈值和阻抗保持低且稳定。

title: How Should an Embolized Atrial Leadless Pacemaker Be Retrieved From the Pulmonary Artery?
Loss of Septal Q Waves Is Associated With QRS Widening After Transcatheter Aortic Valve Implantation.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Conduction disturbances remain a common complication following transcatheter aortic valve implantation (TAVI). While baseline conduction abnormalities are well-established predictors of post-procedural conduction disease or permanent pacemaker implantation, risk stratification in patients without baseline PR or QRS prolongation remains limited. Loss of septal Q waves (LSQ) may reflect underlying conduction system vulnerability but has not been systematically evaluated in this setting.

METHODS: We conducted a retrospective observational study of consecutive patients undergoing TAVI at a single tertiary center between 2018 and 2024. Patients without baseline PR or QRS prolongation were included. LSQ was defined as the absence of Q waves in leads I, V5, and V6. The primary outcome was an increase in QRS duration ≥ 20 ms.

RESULTS: Among 87 patients without baseline PR or QRS prolongation, 86 were evaluable for the primary outcome and QRS widening ≥20 ms occurred in 31 patients (36.0%). LSQ was present in 40.2% of patients. LSQ was associated with increased odds of QRS widening in unadjusted analysis (OR 2.71, 95% CI 1.09-6.74; p = 0.031). The association remained significant after adjustment for AF (adjusted OR 2.76, 95% CI 1.07-7.11; p = 0.035) (Table 2). AF was also independently associated with QRS widening (adjusted OR 3.79, 95% CI 1.10-13.08; p = 0.035).

CONCLUSION: LSQ on pre-procedural ECG was independently associated with post-procedural QRS widening in patients undergoing TAVI without baseline PR or QRS prolongation. LSQ may serve as a simple, non-invasive marker of conduction system vulnerability with potential utility in risk stratification and post-procedural monitoring. These findings are hypothesis generating and warrant validation in larger prospective cohorts.

AI.tldr: 在基线PR与QRS均正常的TAVI患者中，术前心电图室间隔Q波消失（LSQ）与术后QRS增宽≥20 ms独立相关（校正OR 2.76），提示其可作为传导系统易损性的简易无创标志。
AI.motivation: 传导障碍是TAVI术后常见并发症。基线PR或QRS延长已明确可预测术后传导病及永久起搏器植入，但对基线PR与QRS均正常的患者，风险分层手段有限。LSQ可能反映传导系统潜在易损性，但此前未在该人群中系统评估。
AI.method: 单中心回顾性观察研究，纳入2018—2024年连续接受TAVI且基线无PR或QRS延长的患者。LSQ定义为I、V5、V6导联Q波缺失。主要终点为术后QRS时限增加≥20 ms。采用logistic回归分析，并校正AF。
AI.result: 87例患者中86例可评估主要终点，31例（36.0%）出现QRS增宽≥20 ms；LSQ发生率为40.2%。未校正分析中LSQ与QRS增宽相关（OR 2.71，95%CI 1.09–6.74，P=0.031）；校正AF后仍显著（校正OR 2.76，95%CI 1.07–7.11，P=0.035）。AF亦独立相关（校正OR 3.79，95%CI 1.10–13.08，P=0.035）。
AI.conclusion: 术前LSQ是TAVI术后QRS增宽的独立相关因素，可能作为传导系统易损性的简易无创标志，用于风险分层与术后监测。但本研究为单中心回顾性、样本量小（86例），属假说生成性质，需更大样本前瞻性队列验证。

背景：传导障碍仍然是经导管主动脉瓣植入术（TAVI）后常见的并发症。虽然基线传导异常是术后传导疾病或永久起搏器植入的明确预测因素，但对于基线PR或QRS间期未延长的患者，风险分层仍然有限。间隔Q波丢失（LSQ）可能反映潜在的传导系统易损性，但尚未在此背景下进行系统评估。

方法：我们进行了一项回顾性观察性研究，纳入2018年至2024年间在单一三级中心连续接受TAVI的患者。纳入基线PR或QRS间期未延长的患者。LSQ定义为I、V5和V6导联Q波缺失。主要结局为QRS时限增加≥20 ms。

结果：在87例基线PR或QRS间期未延长的患者中，86例可评估主要结局，31例（36.0%）出现QRS增宽≥20 ms。40.2%的患者存在LSQ。在未调整分析中，LSQ与QRS增宽的几率增加相关（OR 2.71，95% CI 1.09-6.74；p = 0.031）。调整AF后，该关联仍然显著（调整后OR 2.76，95% CI 1.07-7.11；p = 0.035）（表2）。AF也与QRS增宽独立相关（调整后OR 3.79，95% CI 1.10-13.08；p = 0.035）。

结论：在基线PR或QRS间期未延长的TAVI患者中，术前心电图LSQ与术后QRS增宽独立相关。LSQ可能作为一种简单、无创的传导系统易损性标志物，在风险分层和术后监测中具有潜在应用价值。这些发现是假设生成性的，需要在更大的前瞻性队列中验证。

title: Early Cardiotoxicity in Pediatric Patients with Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia and Hodgkin Lymphoma: Incidence, Risk Factors, and Clinical Implications
summary: Background: Cardiotoxicity is a major adverse effect of antineoplastic therapy in pediatric oncology, potentially leading to long-term morbidity. This study aimed to evaluate the incidence, spectrum, and risk factors of early cardiovascular (CV) complications in children treated for acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL) and Hodgkin lymphoma (HL). Methods: In this retrospective cohort study, 109 patients diagnosed with ALL or HL between 2013 and 2019 were analyzed. All patients were under 18 years at diagnosis. CV assessment included electrocardiography, echocardiography, blood pressure and Holter monitoring, and additional imaging where available. Early cardiotoxicity was defined as CV events occurring during or shortly after therapy, including echocardiographic abnormalities, arrhythmias, arterial hypertension, and other CV complications. Descriptive and exploratory statistical analyses were performed to identify potential risk factors. Results: Early CV events occurred in 69% of ALL patients and 68% of HL patients. Multiple CV events were observed in 32% of ALL and 36% of HL patients. Most cardiotoxic effects were subclinical or transient; clinically significant CV complications were rarely detected. These comprised treatment-requiring heart failure, arterial hypertension, and thromboembolic events. Persistent CV abnormalities were also observed, including subclinical cardiac dysfunction, arterial hypertension, and cardiac arrhythmias. The majority of CV complications occurred within the first 500 days after therapy initiation. Increased cardiotoxicity was associated with older age, higher treatment risk groups, and disease relapse, while no significant sex differences were identified. Conclusions: CV abnormalities were frequent in children and adolescents receiving treatment for ALL or HL, although most were subclinical or transient. Clinically significant CV complications were uncommon. These findings support systematic CV surveillance during and after pediatric cancer therapy, with particular attention to persistent abnormalities and potentially treatable complications.

AI.tldr: 儿童ALL和HL患者早期心血管事件发生率约69%，但多数为亚临床或一过性，临床显著并发症少见，需系统监测。
AI.motivation: 儿童肿瘤患者接受抗肿瘤治疗后心血管毒性是重要不良反应，可能导致长期病残，但关于儿童ALL和HL早期心血管并发症的发生率、谱系和危险因素的数据有限。
AI.method: 回顾性队列研究，纳入2013-2019年诊断的109例ALL或HL患者（诊断时<18岁）。心血管评估包括心电图、超声心动图、血压和动态心电图监测，以及可用的额外影像学检查。早期心脏毒性定义为治疗期间或治疗后不久发生的心血管事件，包括超声心动图异常、心律失常、动脉高血压和其他心血管并发症。采用描述性和探索性统计分析识别潜在危险因素。
AI.result: 早期心血管事件在ALL患者中发生率为69%，HL患者为68%。多个心血管事件在ALL中占32%，HL中占36%。大多数心脏毒性作用为亚临床或一过性；临床显著心血管并发症罕见，包括需要治疗的心力衰竭、动脉高血压和血栓栓塞事件。持续性心血管异常包括亚临床心功能障碍、动脉高血压和心律失常。大多数心血管并发症发生在治疗开始后500天内。心脏毒性增加与年龄较大、较高治疗风险组和疾病复发相关，未发现显著性别差异。
AI.conclusion: 儿童和青少年ALL或HL治疗期间心血管异常常见，但多数为亚临床或一过性，临床显著并发症不常见。这些发现支持在儿童癌症治疗期间和治疗后系统进行心血管监测，特别关注持续性异常和可治疗的并发症。

summary_zh: 背景：心脏毒性是儿童肿瘤学中抗肿瘤治疗的主要不良反应，可能导致长期发病率。本研究旨在评估接受急性淋巴细胞白血病（ALL）和霍奇金淋巴瘤（HL）治疗的儿童中早期心血管（CV）并发症的发生率、谱系和危险因素。方法：在这项回顾性队列研究中，分析了2013年至2019年间诊断为ALL或HL的109例患者。所有患者诊断时均未满18岁。CV评估包括心电图、超声心动图、血压和动态心电图监测，以及可用的额外影像学检查。早期心脏毒性定义为治疗期间或治疗后不久发生的CV事件，包括超声心动图异常、心律失常、动脉高血压和其他CV并发症。进行了描述性和探索性统计分析以确定潜在的危险因素。结果：早期CV事件发生在69%的ALL患者和68%的HL患者中。在32%的ALL和36%的HL患者中观察到多个CV事件。大多数心脏毒性效应为亚临床或一过性；临床显著的CV并发症罕见发现。这些包括需要治疗的心力衰竭、动脉高血压和血栓栓塞事件。还观察到持续性CV异常，包括亚临床心功能障碍、动脉高血压和心律失常。大多数CV并发症发生在治疗开始后的前500天内。心脏毒性增加与年龄较大、较高治疗风险组和疾病复发相关，而未发现显著的性别差异。结论：在接受ALL或HL治疗的儿童和青少年中，CV异常常见，尽管大多数为亚临床或一过性。临床显著的CV并发症不常见。这些发现支持在儿童癌症治疗期间和治疗后进行系统性CV监测，特别关注持续性异常和潜在可治疗的并发症。

title: Clinical Benefit of the Transthyretin Stabiliser Tafamidis in Hereditary Transthyretin Amyloid Cardiomyopathy: A Case Report
summary: Aims/Background: This case report aims to illustrate the critical importance of a standardized diagnostic approach and genotype-specific therapy in hereditary transthyretin amyloid cardiomyopathy (ATTR-CM). It highlights the clinical challenge of diagnosing ATTR-CM amidst complex comorbidities and addresses the evidence gap regarding the long-term efficacy of tafamidis for the rare and aggressive p.Val40Ile (protein-level substitution of valine to isoleucine at codon 40) mutation. Case Presentation: A 72-year-old East Asian man with multiple comorbidities presented with refractory heart failure. Key clinical clues included the classic “red flag” of electrocardiogram (ECG)-echocardiogram discordance (low voltage with ventricular hypertrophy). Genetic testing identified the pathogenic p.Val40Ile transthyretin (TTR) mutation. Results: The diagnosis was confirmed non-invasively via cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) and technetium-99m pyrophosphate scintigraphy. Following the initiation of tafamidis, the patient’s symptoms significantly improved. Over a two-year follow-up period, he sustained clinical stability with a marked reduction in heart failure-related hospitalizations. Conclusion: This report provides detailed case-based evidence supporting the long-term efficacy of tafamidis in stabilizing disease and improving prognosis for patients with ATTR-CM harboring the p.Val40Ile mutation. It underscores the value of timely diagnosis, genetic subtyping, and access to targeted therapy in altering the clinical course of this aggressive genotype.

AI.tldr: 一例携带p.Val40Ile突变的遗传性ATTR-CM患者，经tafamidis治疗两年内心衰住院显著减少且病情稳定。
AI.motivation: 遗传性转甲状腺素蛋白淀粉样心肌病（ATTR-CM）诊断常因合并症复杂而延误，且罕见侵袭性p.Val40Ile突变缺乏tafamidis长期疗效证据。
AI.method: 个案报告。72岁东亚男性，多种合并症，表现为难治性心衰；通过心电图-超声心动图不匹配（低电压伴心室肥厚）识别，基因检测确诊p.Val40Ile TTR突变，经心脏磁共振和99mTc-PYP闪烁显像无创确诊；启动tafamidis治疗并随访两年，观察症状、临床稳定性及心衰相关住院。
AI.result: 摘要未报告具体统计数值；描述性结果显示，启动tafamidis后患者症状显著改善，两年随访期间临床稳定，心衰相关住院明显减少。
AI.conclusion: 该病例支持tafamidis对p.Val40Ile突变ATTR-CM患者具有长期稳定病情和改善预后的作用，强调及时诊断、基因分型及靶向治疗可改变侵袭性基因型的临床病程；但为单个病例报告，证据级别有限。

summary_zh:
目的/背景：本病例报告旨在阐明标准化诊断方法和基因型特异性治疗在遗传性转甲状腺素蛋白淀粉样心肌病（ATTR-CM）中的关键重要性。它强调了在复杂合并症中诊断ATTR-CM的临床挑战，并填补了关于tafamidis对罕见且侵袭性p.Val40Ile（蛋白质水平上第40位密码子缬氨酸被异亮氨酸取代）突变长期疗效的证据空白。

病例介绍：一名72岁东亚男性，有多种合并症，表现为难治性心力衰竭。关键临床线索包括心电图（ECG）与超声心动图不一致（低电压伴心室肥厚）的经典“红旗”征。基因检测发现了致病性p.Val40Ile转甲状腺素蛋白（TTR）突变。

结果：通过心脏磁共振（CMR）和锝-99m焦磷酸盐闪烁显像非侵入性确诊。开始tafamidis治疗后，患者症状显著改善。在两年随访期内，他保持临床稳定，心力衰竭相关住院次数明显减少。

结论：本报告提供了详细的病例证据，支持tafamidis在稳定携带p.Val40Ile突变的ATTR-CM患者疾病和改善预后方面的长期疗效。它强调了及时诊断、基因亚型分型和获得靶向治疗在改变这种侵袭性基因型临床病程中的价值。

title: Abstract C012: Further insights into the variable expressivity of fumarate hydratase (FH) – tumor predisposition syndrome
summary: Abstract Fumarate hydratase (FH) – tumor predisposition syndrome is an autosomal dominant cancer predisposition syndrome caused by mutations in the fumarate hydratase (FH) gene, which may ultimately lead to clinical manifestations of cutaneous leiomyomata, uterine leiomyomata (fibroids), renal cell carcinoma (RCC), pheochromocytomas, and/or paragangliomas. While the natural history and penetrance pattern of FH-RCC remains unknown, it usually occurs in adults about 30-40 years of age, presents as a solitary lesion, and is highly aggressive. Here, we describe a 16-year-old male with a past medical history of cortical dysplasia with intractable epilepsy (status post (s/p) hemispherectomy and sequelae of left hemiparesis, partial blindness, mild cognitive impairments), and erythrocytosis who presented with fatigue, weight loss, cough, and abdominal pain. Physical exam showed eczematous skin changes, scattered papules, ruddy complexion, and abdominal distention. Initial imaging revealed significant mediastinal lymphadenopathy which prompted subsequent imaging that showed a left renal mass, diffuse bony lesions throughout the skeleton, and widespread lymphadenopathy. Biopsy and next-generation sequencing (NGS) of a prominent iliac lesion revealed a diagnosis of widely metastatic FH-deficient RCC. NGS analysis identified a loss of function missense mutation in the FH gene (FH p.H235D) at a high allelic burden (79%) in exon 5 along with copy number gains of chromosomes 7 and 17. Furthermore, germline testing corroborated this diagnosis with detection of a likely pathogenic variant, FH p.H235D. Family history was notable for uterine fibroids in mother (s/p hysterectomy), colonic polyps and arrhythmia in father, and various cancer types in distant, older relatives. Cascade testing revealed the exact same pathogenic variant, FH p.H235D, in patient’s older sister and mother. Fortunately, patient’s mother and sister remain healthy and are now followed routinely to ensure appropriate tumor surveillance. Unlike these family members, our patient presented with advanced stage RCC requiring a combination of upfront Bevacizumab and Erlotinib therapy, followed by palliative radiation. His disease progressed quickly and therapy was changed to dual immune checkpoint inhibitors, followed by Belzutifan therapy, and then Cabozantinib monotherapy. His disease continued to progress, and he died about 11 months following diagnosis. Interestingly, it remains unclear if our patient’s previous cortical dysplasia (brain) and longstanding erythrocytosis influenced the underlying biology of his FH-RCC. Our case study highlights the unique presentation of widely metastatic, treatment-resistant FH-RCC in a pediatric patient and the importance of germline, somatic, and cascade genetic testing. Moreover, our experience provides further evidence to improve our understanding of FH variant pathogenicity, the natural history pattern of FH-RCC, molecular underpinnings of tumor development, and optimal disease surveillance in pediatric patients with FH-tumor predisposition syndrome. In: Proceedings of the AACR Special Conference in Cancer Research: Bridging Discovery and Clinical Impact in Pediatric Cancer; 2026 Sep 22-25; Philadelphia, PA. Philadelphia (PA): AACR; Cancer Res 2026;86(18_Suppl_1):Abstract nr C012.

AI.tldr: 一例16岁男性携带FH p.H235D胚系致病突变的延胡索酸水合酶肿瘤易感综合征患者，以广泛转移性FH缺陷型肾细胞癌就诊，确诊后约11个月死亡。
AI.motivation: FH肿瘤易感综合征为常染色体显性遗传的肿瘤易感综合征，可表现为皮肤和子宫平滑肌瘤、肾细胞癌（RCC）、嗜铬细胞瘤及副神经节瘤，但FH-RCC的自然史与外显率模式尚不明确，儿科患者中的表现与监测策略证据缺乏。
AI.method: 个案报告（摘要未报告研究类型、样本量与统计方法）。对象为16岁男性，既往有皮质发育不良伴难治性癫痫（半球切除术后，遗留左侧偏瘫、部分失明、轻度认知障碍）及红细胞增多症；因乏力、体重下降、咳嗽、腹痛就诊。影像示纵隔淋巴结显著肿大、左肾肿块、全身弥漫性骨病变及广泛淋巴结肿大；髂骨病灶活检及二代测序（NGS）确诊广泛转移性FH缺陷型RCC，并行胚系检测与家系级联检测。

title: Postmortem DNA methylation profiling uncovers signatures associated with left ventricle size
summary: 1 Abstract Aims Postmortem genetic testing is a crucial tool to determine the cause of sudden cardiac death and to enable family testing of relatives. While DNA variants are extensively studied in sudden cardiac death, the role of DNA methylation alterations is poorly understood. In contrast to DNA variants, DNA methylation is tissue-specific. Therefore, it is essential to determine the most relevant anatomical regions for tissue sampling. We aimed to assess the importance of standardised sampling procedures in the investigation of DNA methylation in the human ventricles. Methods and results We used the Infinium MethylationEPIC array technology to profile the DNA methylation levels among 771,458 CpG sites in the left ventricle, septum, and right ventricle of 15 individuals who died due to sudden cardiac death. We identified 256 differentially methylated regions in the left and right ventricles and the septum. Notably, regions differentially methylated in the left and right ventricles were located in proximity to genes overrepresented in gene ontology terms related to the formation and growth of the human heart. Furthermore, the left ventricle size was correlated with DNA methylation alterations in proximity to the PITX2 (Pearson’s R 2 = 0.54, P = 0.007) and PANCR genes (Pearson’s R 2 = 0.51, P = 0.009). We observed no clustering among the samples from the left and right ventricles and the septum in the examination of all sites. The top 0.1% most variable sites (771 CpG sites) clustered by individual rather than by anatomical origin. Conclusion We showed that DNA methylation differences of the ventricles near PITX2 and PANCR are associated with left ventricle size. Our findings highlight the importance of standardised tissue collection from multiple regions of the cardiac ventricles in postmortem DNA methylation investigations of the human heart.

AI.tldr: 在15例心脏性猝死个体中，左心室大小与PITX2和PANCR基因附近DNA甲基化改变相关，提示死后多区域标准化取材对甲基化研究的重要性。
AI.motivation: 死后基因检测是确定心脏性猝死病因和进行家属筛查的关键工具，但DNA甲基化改变在心脏性猝死中的作用尚不清楚。与DNA变异不同，DNA甲基化具有组织特异性，因此确定最相关的解剖区域进行组织采样至关重要。本研究旨在评估标准化采样程序在人心室DNA甲基化研究中的重要性。
AI.method: 研究采用Infinium MethylationEPIC芯片技术，对15例死于心脏性猝死个体的左心室、室间隔和右心室共771,458个CpG位点的DNA甲基化水平进行检测。分析左右心室及室间隔之间的差异甲基化区域，并评估左心室大小与DNA甲基化改变的相关性。统计方法包括差异甲基化区域分析和Pearson相关性分析。
AI.result: 在左心室、右心室和室间隔中鉴定出256个差异甲基化区域。左右心室差异甲基化区域邻近的基因富集于与人类心脏形成和生长相关的基因本体条目。左心室大小与PITX2基因附近的DNA甲基化改变相关（Pearson's R²=0.54，P=0.007），与PANCR基因附近的改变亦相关（Pearson's R²=0.51，P=0.009）。在所有位点分析中，左右心室和室间隔样本未见聚类；变异最大的0.1%位点（771个CpG）按个体而非解剖来源聚类。
AI.conclusion: 本研究表明心室中PITX2和PANCR附近的DNA甲基化差异与左心室大小相关。研究结果强调了在人类心脏死后DNA甲基化研究中从心室多个区域标准化采集组织的重要性，对心脏性猝死的分子解剖和后续研究具有指导意义。摘要未报告研究的局限性。

摘要

目的
死后基因检测是确定心源性猝死原因并使亲属能够进行家庭检测的重要工具。虽然DNA变异在心源性猝死中已被广泛研究，但DNA甲基化改变的作用却知之甚少。与DNA变异不同，DNA甲基化具有组织特异性。因此，确定用于组织采样的最相关解剖区域至关重要。我们旨在评估标准化采样程序在人心室DNA甲基化研究中的重要性。

方法与结果
我们使用Infinium MethylationEPIC阵列技术，对15例死于心源性猝死个体的左心室、室间隔和右心室的771,458个CpG位点的DNA甲基化水平进行了分析。我们在左心室、右心室和室间隔中识别出256个差异甲基化区域。值得注意的是，左心室和右心室中差异甲基化的区域位于基因附近，这些基因在与人心脏形成和生长相关的基因本体论术语中过度代表。此外，左心室大小与PITX2（Pearson's R² = 0.54，P = 0.007）和PANCR基因（Pearson's R² = 0.51，P = 0.009）附近的DNA甲基化改变相关。在检查所有位点时，我们未观察到左心室、右心室和室间隔样本之间的聚类。变异最大的前0.1%位点（771个CpG位点）按个体而非解剖来源聚类。

我们表明，心室中PITX2和PANCR附近的DNA甲基化差异与左心室大小相关。我们的发现强调了在人类心脏死后DNA甲基化研究中，从心脏心室多个区域标准化采集组织的重要性。

title: Calpain-Dependent Protein Degradation Contributes to CASQ2-R33Q CPVT.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Catecholaminergic polymorphic ventricular tachycardia (CPVT) is an inherited arrhythmogenic disease associated with cardiac arrest in children and young adults. The recessive form of CPVT is caused by loss-of-function mutations in the genes encoding CASQ2 and TRDN, which, together with JCTN, regulate the release of calcium ions from the sarcoplasmic reticulum through the RyR2 (ryanodine receptor). The CASQ2 R33Q mutation causes calcium mishandling and ventricular tachycardia through triggered activity. The homozygous mouse model Casq2R33Q/R33Q closely replicates the clinical phenotype of patients with CPVT. In this model, CASQ2 (calsequestrin 2), TRDN (triadin), and JCTN (junctin) levels are markedly reduced; however, the mechanisms underlying this reduction and their contribution to CPVT are incompletely understood.

METHODS: We used a combination of proteomics, animal models, and experimental methods to identify the molecular mechanisms responsible for the decrease of couplon proteins in Casq2R33Q/R33Q mice and to explore their functional contribution to the disease.

RESULTS: Casq2R33Q/R33Q hearts showed activation of endoplasmic reticulum stress, the unfolded protein response, and alterations in major proteolytic pathways. Inhibition of the proteasome or autophagy in neonatal cardiomyocytes and adult mice partially restored CASQ2 but not TRDN levels, suggesting distinct degradation mechanisms. In contrast, calpain inhibition restored CASQ2 and TRDN protein levels, decreased triggered activity in isolated cardiomyocytes, and reduced ventricular tachycardia episodes in vivo in Casq2R33Q/R33Q mice. Biochemical assays showed that TRDN is a direct calpain substrate. TRDN degradation preceded CASQ2 loss, and TRDN overexpression using modified RNA in cardiomyocytes or an adeno-associated viral vector in vivo increased CASQ2 levels in mutant mice, supporting an upstream role for TRDN destabilization.

CONCLUSIONS: Couplon protein loss in CPVT associated with CASQ2-R33Q is mediated by coordinated but distinct proteolytic pathways, with calpain-dependent TRDN degradation representing a key pathogenic event that promotes CASQ2 destabilization and arrhythmogenesis.

AI.tldr: 在CASQ2-R33Q CPVT小鼠模型中，钙蛋白酶（calpain）依赖的TRDN降解是导致CASQ2不稳定和心律失常发生的关键致病事件，抑制calpain可恢复蛋白水平并减少室速。
AI.motivation: CASQ2-R33Q突变导致隐性遗传性CPVT，既往发现Casq2R33Q/R33Q小鼠中CASQ2、TRDN和JCTN蛋白水平显著降低，但其降低机制及对CPVT的贡献尚不完全清楚。
AI.method: 研究采用蛋白质组学、动物模型和实验方法，在Casq2R33Q/R33Q小鼠中鉴定couplon蛋白减少的分子机制，并探索其功能贡献；在新生大鼠心肌细胞和成年小鼠中分别抑制蛋白酶体、自噬或calpain，评估对蛋白水平、触发活动和室速发作的影响。
AI.result: Casq2R33Q/R33Q心脏显示内质网应激、未折叠蛋白反应激活及主要蛋白水解途径改变。抑制蛋白酶体或自噬部分恢复CASQ2但不恢复TRDN水平；抑制calpain则恢复CASQ2和TRDN蛋白水平，减少分离心肌细胞的触发活动，并减少在体室速发作。生化实验显示TRDN是calpain的直接底物，TRDN降解先于CASQ2丢失；通过修饰RNA或腺相关病毒载体过表达TRDN可增加突变小鼠的CASQ2水平。
AI.conclusion: CASQ2-R33Q相关CPVT中couplon蛋白丢失由协调但不同的蛋白水解途径介导，calpain依赖的TRDN降解是促进CASQ2不稳定和心律失常发生的关键致病事件；抑制calpain或过表达TRDN可能成为治疗策略，但需进一步临床验证。

summary_zh:
背景：儿茶酚胺敏感性多形性室性心动过速（CPVT）是一种遗传性致心律失常性疾病，与儿童和年轻成人的心脏骤停相关。CPVT的隐性形式由编码CASQ2和TRDN的基因功能丧失突变引起，这两种蛋白与JCTN一起，通过RyR2（兰尼碱受体）调节肌浆网钙离子的释放。CASQ2 R33Q突变通过触发活动导致钙处理异常和室性心动过速。纯合小鼠模型Casq2R33Q/R33Q密切复制了CPVT患者的临床表型。在该模型中，CASQ2（肌集钙蛋白2）、TRDN（三联蛋白）和JCTN（连接蛋白）水平显著降低；然而，这种降低的机制及其对CPVT的贡献尚不完全清楚。

方法：我们结合蛋白质组学、动物模型和实验方法，以确定Casq2R33Q/R33Q小鼠中偶联蛋白减少的分子机制，并探索其对疾病的功能贡献。

结果：Casq2R33Q/R33Q心脏显示内质网应激、未折叠蛋白反应的激活以及主要蛋白水解途径的改变。在新生心肌细胞和成年小鼠中抑制蛋白酶体或自噬部分恢复了CASQ2但未恢复TRDN水平，提示不同的降解机制。相反，抑制钙蛋白酶恢复了CASQ2和TRDN蛋白水平，减少了分离心肌细胞中的触发活动，并减少了Casq2R33Q/R33Q小鼠体内的室性心动过速发作。生化实验表明TRDN是钙蛋白酶的直接底物。TRDN降解先于CASQ2丢失，在心肌细胞中使用修饰RNA或在体内使用腺相关病毒载体过表达TRDN增加了突变小鼠的CASQ2水平，支持TRDN去稳定化的上游作用。

结论：与CASQ2-R33Q相关的CPVT中偶联蛋白丢失由协调但不同的蛋白水解途径介导，其中钙蛋白酶依赖的TRDN降解代表了一个关键致病事件，促进CASQ2去稳定化和心律失常发生。

title: Targeting trafficking defects in long QT syndrome type 2: a phase 2 clinical study with patient-specific cellular validation.
summary:
BACKGROUND AND AIMS: A major component of long QT syndrome (LQTS) is LQT2 due to pathogenic variants in KCNH2, which frequently cause trafficking defects. Despite progress in therapeutic management, there is an unmet clinical need for mechanism-targeted therapies. It has been previously shown, using patient-specific human induced pluripotent stem cell-derived cardiomyocytes (hiPSC-CMs), that lumacaftor (LUM), currently used for cystic fibrosis, can partially correct hERG trafficking. A single-arm phase 2 study was conducted to determine whether LUM could shorten QTc in LQT2 patients with trafficking defects.

METHODS: Sixteen adult patients with genetically confirmed trafficking-defective KCNH2 variants were enrolled. Participants were admitted to hospital and received LUM for 7 days under continuous telemetry. QTc was quantified on serial electrocardiograms and 12-lead Holter recordings. For mechanistic correlation, hiPSC-CMs were generated from the first five participants with distinct genetic variants and assessed for hERG maturation and trafficking.

RESULTS: Overall, lumacaftor produced a significant QTc shortening (P < .001). The per-patient change averaged 31 ± 21 ms. Patients with baseline QTc ≥500 ms exhibited the most substantial effect, with 75% achieving reductions ≥40 ms. No ventricular arrhythmias occurred, and adverse effects were primarily gastrointestinal and self-limited. In hiPSC-CMs, LUM restored hERG trafficking in three out of five variants, mirroring the clinical observations.

CONCLUSIONS: Short-term LUM therapy is safe and yields a significant QTc shortening in LQT2 patients with a trafficking defect. Concordance between cellular and clinical findings reinforces the value of a mechanism-based, variant-informed approach and supports the feasibility of trafficking-correction strategies within a precision-medicine framework for inherited arrhythmia syndromes.

AI.tldr: 在16例KCNH2转运缺陷型LQT2患者中，7天lumacaftor治疗使QTc平均缩短31±21 ms，且安全耐受，细胞学验证部分变异型hERG转运恢复。
AI.motivation: LQT2由KCNH2致病变异引起，常导致hERG蛋白转运缺陷；现有治疗非机制靶向，存在未满足的临床需求。既往患者特异性hiPSC-CMs研究提示lumacaftor可部分纠正hERG转运，但缺乏临床验证。
AI.method: 单臂2期临床研究，纳入16例基因确诊为转运缺陷型KCNH2变异的成人LQT2患者，住院接受lumacaftor治疗7天并持续心电遥测；通过系列心电图和12导联Holter量化QTc。对前5例不同基因变异患者生成hiPSC-CMs，评估hERG成熟与转运。
AI.result: lumacaftor整体显著缩短QTc（P<0.001），患者平均变化31±21 ms；基线QTc≥500 ms者效果最显著，75%达到≥40 ms的缩短。无室性心律失常发生，不良反应主要为自限性胃肠道反应。hiPSC-CMs中，5种变异中有3种LUM恢复了hERG转运，与临床观察一致。
AI.conclusion: 短期lumacaftor治疗在转运缺陷型LQT2患者中安全且显著缩短QTc；细胞与临床结果一致，支持基于机制和变异信息的精准医学策略用于遗传性心律失常综合征，但样本量小、单臂设计需进一步验证。

summary_zh:
背景与目的：长QT综合征（LQTS）的一个重要组成部分是LQT2，由KCNH2致病性变异引起，这些变异常导致转运缺陷。尽管治疗管理取得了进展，但对针对机制的疗法仍存在未满足的临床需求。此前利用患者特异性人诱导多能干细胞衍生心肌细胞（hiPSC-CMs）已表明，目前用于囊性纤维化的lumacaftor（LUM）可部分纠正hERG转运。本研究开展了一项单臂2期研究，以确定LUM能否缩短伴有转运缺陷的LQT2患者的QTc。

方法：纳入16例经基因确诊携带转运缺陷型KCNH2变异的成年患者。参与者住院并接受LUM治疗7天，期间持续遥测监测。通过系列心电图和12导联Holter记录定量QTc。为进行机制相关性分析，从具有不同基因变异的前五位参与者中生成hiPSC-CMs，并评估hERG成熟和转运。

结果：总体而言，lumacaftor产生了显著的QTc缩短（P < .001）。每例患者平均变化为31 ± 21 ms。基线QTc ≥500 ms的患者表现出最显著的效果，其中75%达到≥40 ms的降低。未发生室性心律失常，不良反应主要为胃肠道反应且呈自限性。在hiPSC-CMs中，LUM在五个变异中的三个恢复了hERG转运，与临床观察结果一致。

结论：短期LUM治疗是安全的，并在伴有转运缺陷的LQT2患者中产生显著的QTc缩短。细胞与临床发现之间的一致性强化了基于机制、依据变异类型的方法的价值，并支持在遗传性心律失常综合征的精准医学框架内实施转运纠正策略的可行性。

title: Progressive conduction system disease preceding hypertrophy in IVS4+919G>A Fabry variant: a population-based electrocardiographic study.
summary:
AIMS: The IVS4+919G>A variant is the most prevalent late-onset Fabry variant in East Asian populations, but its electrophysiological trajectory remains incompletely defined.

METHODS AND RESULTS: From a regional genetic screening programme, 905 IVS4+919G>A carriers were identified among 457 581 patients and matched 1:2 to controls by age and sex. Electrocardiographic (ECG) parameters were compared across decades, and echocardiography correlated structural changes with ECG findings. The cumulative prevalence of IVS4+919G>A was 0.198%. Age-specific prevalence in females was ∼2.5-fold higher than in males (0.11-0.15%), without significant change throughout different age categories. Female carriers demonstrated the catch-up phenomenon after the age of 60. Males exhibited a nine-fold risk of right bundle branch block and pacemaker implantation compared with male controls (right bundle branch block, HR 9.286, 95% CI 5.16-16.70, P < 0.001; pacemaker implantation, HR 9.197, 95% CI 2.88-29.31, P < 0.001), and this precedes the onset of echocardiographic left ventricular hypertrophy. Risk of stroke and atrial fibrillation (HR 1.435, 95% CI 0.69-2.96, P = 0.289) was similar between male carriers and controls. PR interval did not shorten but was prolonged instead. Combining left ventricular hypertrophy with conduction abnormalities, ECG detection achieved 88% sensitivity, exceeding echocardiographic criteria alone (51.5%).

CONCLUSION: The IVS4+919G>A variant is characterized by a progressive electrical phenotype dominated by conduction system disease preceding hypertrophy without excess major arrhythmic events. Electrocardiographic surveillance and phenotype-based risk stratification may be more informative than structural assessment alone for identifying individuals at risk of device therapy.Institutional Review Board: CMUH113-REC3-076.

AI.tldr: IVS4+919G>A法布雷变异携带者以进行性传导系统疾病为主要电学表型，早于左室肥厚出现，男性起搏器植入风险增加9倍，心电图联合左室肥厚检测敏感性达88%。
AI.motivation: IVS4+919G>A是东亚最常见的晚发型法布雷变异，但其电生理演变轨迹尚不明确，既往缺乏基于人群的大样本心电图特征描述，临床识别和风险分层存在缺口。
AI.method: 基于区域遗传筛查项目，从457,581例患者中识别905例IVS4+919G>A携带者，按年龄和性别1:2匹配对照。比较各年龄段心电图参数，并行超声心动图与心电图相关性分析。主要终点为心电图传导异常、起搏器植入及房颤/卒中风险，采用风险比（HR）及95%CI评估。
AI.result: 携带者累积患病率0.198%，女性年龄别患病率约为男性2.5倍，60岁后出现追赶现象。男性携带者右束支传导阻滞风险为对照9.286倍（95%CI 5.16-16.70，P<0.001），起搏器植入风险9.197倍（95%CI 2.88-29.31，P<0.001），且均早于超声左室肥厚出现。卒中及房颤风险与对照相似（HR 1.435，95%CI 0.69-2.96，P=0.289）。PR间期延长而非缩短。左室肥厚联合传导异常的心电图检测敏感性88%，高于单纯超声标准（51.5%）。
AI.conclusion: IVS4+919G>A变异以进行性传导系统疾病为突出电学表型，早于心肌肥厚，但未增加主要心律失常事件。心电图监测和基于表型的风险分层可能比单纯结构评估更有助于识别需要器械治疗的高危个体，但本研究为观察性设计，需前瞻性验证。

summary_zh:
目的：IVS4+919G>A变异是东亚人群中最常见的迟发型Fabry变异，但其电生理轨迹仍未完全明确。

方法与结果：从一项区域性基因筛查项目中，在457 581例患者中识别出905例IVS4+919G>A携带者，并按年龄和性别以1:2匹配对照。比较了不同十年间的 electrocardiographic（ECG）参数，并将超声心动图的结构变化与ECG发现进行相关性分析。IVS4+919G>A的累积患病率为0.198%。女性的年龄别患病率约为男性的2.5倍（0.11-0.15%），在不同年龄类别中无显著变化。女性携带者在60岁后表现出追赶现象。与男性对照相比，男性携带者发生右束支传导阻滞和植入起搏器的风险为九倍（右束支传导阻滞，HR 9.286，95% CI 5.16-16.70，P < 0.001；起搏器植入，HR 9.197，95% CI 2.88-29.31，P < 0.001），且这先于超声心动图左心室肥厚的出现。男性携带者与对照之间的卒中和心房颤动风险相似（HR 1.435，95% CI 0.69-2.96，P = 0.289）。PR间期并未缩短，反而延长。结合左心室肥厚与传导异常，ECG检测达到88%的敏感性，超过单独超声心动图标准（51.5%）。

结论：IVS4+919G>A变异的特征是以传导系统疾病为主的进行性电学表型，先于肥厚出现，而无过多主要心律失常事件。对于识别有器械治疗风险的个体， electrocardiographic监测和基于表型的风险分层可能比单独的结构评估提供更多信息。机构审查委员会：CMUH113-REC3-076。

title: The Arrhythmic Burden of Cardiac Amyloidosis: A Comprehensive Review.
summary: Cardiac amyloidosis (CA) represents a growing etiology of heart failure (HF) and arrhythmogenesis, driven by the intramyocardial deposition of aberrantly folded proteins, notably immunoglobulin light chains (AL) and transthyretin (ATTR). This infiltrative process compromises myocardial compliance and disrupts the cardiac conduction system, leading to a diverse spectrum of dysrhythmias. The escalating prevalence of CA, particularly within geriatric demographics and individuals with plasma cell dyscrasias, underscores the imperative for refined diagnostic and therapeutic paradigms. The considerable arrhythmic burden in CA significantly contributes to patient morbidity, thromboembolic events, and sudden cardiac death, thus providing the impetus for this comprehensive review. Despite advancements in cardiac imaging and biomarker analysis, detailed electrophysiological characterization and arrhythmia-specific management strategies in CA remain incompletely elucidated. This review aims to provide a comprehensive overview of current evidence related to the arrhythmic features of CA. In addition, it characterizes the electrophysiological consequences of amyloid infiltration, distinguishes arrhythmic profiles between AL and ATTR subtypes, and evaluates diagnostic methods and treatment options to optimize clinical management decision-making. Atrial fibrillation is a prevalent arrhythmia, particularly in wild-type ATTR amyloidosis. In contrast, AL amyloidosis, characterized by direct myocyte cytotoxicity and accelerated disease progression, frequently manifests with ventricular arrhythmias and conduction disturbances. Ultimately, arrhythmias in CA are multifactorial, necessitating a subtype-specific approach to diagnosis and treatment. Risk stratification, integrating electrocardiographic, imaging, biomarker, and genetic data, is crucial for guiding patient management. Future directions involve personalized treatment frameworks leveraging multiomics integration, remote rhythm monitoring, and artificial intelligence-driven predictive modeling to advance precision electrophysiology in systemic amyloidosis.

AI.tldr: 心脏淀粉样变心律失常负荷重，AL型以室性心律失常和传导障碍为主，ATTR型以房颤为主，需基于亚型制定诊疗策略。
AI.motivation: 心脏淀粉样变是心衰和心律失常的重要病因，其患病率在老年人和浆细胞病患者中上升，但电生理特征和心律失常特异性管理策略尚未完全阐明，且不同亚型（AL与ATTR）的心律失常谱存在差异，需要综合评估以优化临床决策。
AI.method: 本文为综述，旨在总结心脏淀粉样变心律失常特征的当前证据，描述淀粉样蛋白浸润的电生理后果，区分AL和ATTR亚型的心律失常谱，并评估诊断方法和治疗选择。摘要未报告系统检索策略、纳入研究数量或统计方法。
AI.result: 房颤在野生型ATTR淀粉样变中尤为常见；AL淀粉样变因直接心肌细胞毒性和疾病进展快，常表现为室性心律失常和传导障碍。心律失常发生是多因素的，需亚型特异性诊疗。风险分层需整合心电图、影像、生物标志物和遗传数据。摘要未报告具体效应量、置信区间或P值。
AI.conclusion: 心脏淀粉样变的心律失常管理需基于亚型制定个体化策略，风险分层应综合多模态数据。未来方向包括多组学整合、远程节律监测和人工智能预测模型，以推进精准电生理。本文为综述，未提供原始研究数据，结论基于现有证据总结。

summary_zh: 心脏淀粉样变性（CA）是心力衰竭（HF）和心律失常发生的一个日益增多的病因，由异常折叠的蛋白质（尤其是免疫球蛋白轻链（AL）和转甲状腺素蛋白（ATTR））在心肌内沉积所驱动。这一浸润性过程损害心肌顺应性并破坏心脏传导系统，导致多种类型的心律失常。CA患病率的不断上升，尤其是在老年人群和浆细胞病患者中，凸显了改进诊断和治疗模式的必要性。CA中显著的心律失常负担大大增加了患者的发病率、血栓栓塞事件和心源性猝死，从而推动了这篇综合综述的撰写。尽管心脏影像学和生物标志物分析取得了进展，但CA中详细的电生理特征和心律失常特异性管理策略仍未完全阐明。本综述旨在全面概述与CA心律失常特征相关的当前证据。此外，它还描述了淀粉样蛋白浸润的电生理后果，区分了AL和ATTR亚型之间的心律失常特征，并评估了诊断方法和治疗选择，以优化临床管理决策。心房颤动是一种常见的心律失常，尤其是在野生型ATTR淀粉样变性中。相比之下，以直接心肌细胞毒性和疾病进展加速为特征的AL淀粉样变性，常表现为室性心律失常和传导障碍。最终，CA中的心律失常是多因素的，需要针对亚型的诊断和治疗方法。整合心电图、影像学、生物标志物和遗传数据的风险分层对于指导患者管理至关重要。未来的方向涉及利用多组学整合、远程心律监测和人工智能驱动的预测建模的个性化治疗框架，以推进系统性淀粉样变性中的精准电生理学。

title: Multimodality assessment for sudden cardiac death risk stratification in non-ischemic cardiomyopathy: A case-based framework integrating cardiac magnetic resonance, electrophysiologic observations, and genetics.
summary: Sudden cardiac death (SCD) remains a major cause of mortality in nonischemic cardiomyopathy (NICM) despite advances in heart failure therapy and implantable cardioverter-defibrillator (ICD) technology. Risk stratification remains challenging because left ventricular (LV) ejection fraction (LVEF) alone incompletely captures arrhythmic substrate, missing many patients at risk while leading others to receive ICDs without subsequent appropriate therapy. Cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR), particularly late gadolinium enhancement (LGE), has emerged as a central tool for identifying myocardial fibrosis and refining arrhythmic risk across NICM phenotypes. However, CMR imaging alone does not fully define arrhythmogenicity, especially in diseases with layered, septal, or intramural scar. We present a case-based framework illustrating how multimodality imaging integrates into SCD risk stratification across hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, cardiac sarcoidosis, genetic arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy, and cardiac amyloidosis. These cases demonstrate several core principles. First, CMR can identify arrhythmogenic substrate and often refines risk beyond conventional clinical markers. Second, multimodality imaging can provide additive information, but findings must be interpreted within disease-specific context, as the prognostic implications differ across phenotypes. Third, invasive electrophysiologic evaluation, including programmed stimulation and electroanatomic mapping, can further stratify arrhythmic risk when imaging findings are incomplete or discordant with the clinical presentation. Finally, genetic testing complements imaging and invasive assessment by refining disease classification and, in selected cases, contributes to arrhythmic risk assessment by considering variant classification and wholistic clinical phenotype. Together, these observations support a substrate-based rather than function-based approach to SCD risk stratification in NICM. Multimodality imaging is foundational, but optimal assessment requires integration of imaging, electrophysiology, genetics, and clinical phenotype. Future progress will depend on longitudinal risk modeling, improved characterization of electrically active substrate, and incorporation of patient-specific tools into primary prevention ICD decision-making.

AI.tldr: 在非缺血性心肌病中，基于基质的多模态评估（CMR、电生理检查、基因检测）可优化SCD风险分层，弥补单纯LVEF的不足。
AI.motivation: 非缺血性心肌病（NICM）患者SCD风险高，但单纯LVEF不足以捕捉心律失常基质，导致部分高危患者被遗漏，而部分低危患者接受不必要的ICD。CMR（尤其LGE）可识别心肌纤维化，但单独影像无法完全定义致心律失常性，尤其对于分层、间隔或壁内瘢痕。需整合多模态评估以改进风险分层。
AI.method: 本文为基于病例的框架性综述，非原始研究。通过展示肥厚型心肌病、心脏结节病、遗传性致心律失常性心肌病和心脏淀粉样变性等NICM表型的病例，阐述如何整合CMR、有创电生理评估（程序刺激和电解剖标测）和基因检测进行SCD风险分层。摘要未报告样本量、终点定义或统计方法。
AI.result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果。病例展示的核心原则包括：CMR可识别致心律失常基质并常超越传统临床标志物优化风险；多模态影像提供附加信息但需结合疾病特异性背景解读；当影像不完整或与临床表现不一致时，有创电生理评估可进一步分层；基因检测通过细化疾病分类和综合评估变异分类及临床表型，辅助心律失常风险评估。
AI.conclusion: 支持在NICM中采用基于基质而非基于功能的SCD风险分层策略。多模态影像为基础，但最佳评估需整合影像、电生理、遗传学和临床表型。未来需纵向风险建模、更好表征电活动基质，并将患者特异性工具纳入一级预防ICD决策。摘要未报告研究局限性。

summary_zh: 尽管心力衰竭治疗和植入式心律转复除颤器（ICD）技术不断进步，心源性猝死（SCD）仍然是缺血性心肌病（NICM）患者的主要死亡原因。风险分层仍然具有挑战性，因为仅凭左心室（LV）射血分数（LVEF）不能完全捕捉心律失常基质，遗漏了许多有风险的患者，同时导致其他患者接受了ICD却没有后续的适当治疗。心脏磁共振（CMR），特别是晚期钆增强（LGE），已成为识别心肌纤维化和细化NICM表型心律失常风险的核心工具。然而，仅凭CMR成像不能完全定义致心律失常性，特别是在具有层状、间隔或壁内瘢痕的疾病中。我们提出了一个基于病例的框架，说明多模态成像如何整合到肥厚型心肌病、心脏结节病、遗传性致心律失常性心肌病和心脏淀粉样变性的SCD风险分层中。这些病例展示了几个核心原则。首先，CMR可以识别致心律失常基质，并且通常可以超越传统临床标志物来细化风险。其次，多模态成像可以提供附加信息，但发现必须在疾病特异性背景下解读，因为不同表型的预后意义不同。第三，当影像学发现不完整或与临床表现不一致时，侵入性电生理评估，包括程序性刺激和电解剖标测，可以进一步分层心律失常风险。最后，基因检测通过细化疾病分类来补充影像学和侵入性评估，并在选定病例中通过考虑变异分类和整体临床表型来参与心律失常风险评估。总之，这些观察支持在NICM的SCD风险分层中采用基于基质而非基于功能的方法。多模态成像的基础性地位已确立，但最佳评估需要整合影像学、电生理学、遗传学和临床表型。未来的进展将取决于纵向风险建模、电活动基质的更好表征以及将患者特异性工具纳入一级预防ICD决策。

title: Pediatric Catecholaminergic Polymorphic Ventricular Tachycardia: Clinical Characteristics, Genetic Spectrum, and Outcomes in a Multicenter Cohort
summary: Background Catecholaminergic polymorphic ventricular tachycardia (CPVT) is a rare inherited arrhythmia with a high risk of life-threatening ventricular arrhythmias in childhood.Objectives This study sought to characterize pediatric CPVT and evaluate contemporary therapeutic outcomes, including left cardiac sympathetic denervation (LCSD) and bilateral cardiac sympathetic denervation (BCSD).Methods This retrospective multicenter study included 92 pediatric patients with CPVT from 3 tertiary centers in Türkiye between 2012 and 2025. Arrhythmic events included aborted cardiac arrest, sudden cardiac death, appropriate implantable cardioverter-defibrillator shocks, arrhythmic syncope, and ventricular tachycardia. Paired preprocedural and postprocedural event rates were compared in patients with an adequate preprocedural observation period.Results Median age at symptom onset was 9.25 years (IQR: 5.88-12.0), and median age at diagnosis was 11.6 years (IQR: 8.64-14.41). Among 87 genetically tested patients, 74 (85.1%) had a pathogenic or likely pathogenic variant; ryanodine receptor 2 and calsequestrin 2 variants were identified in 41 (47.1%) and 24 (27.6%), respectively. Fifty patients underwent sympathetic denervation (LCSD, n = 25; BCSD, n = 25). In the paired cohort (n = 35), median arrhythmic event rate decreased from 3.20 events/year (IQR: 1.74-8.76) before LCSD/BCSD to 0.00 events/year (IQR: 0.00-1.35) during the first 2 postprocedural years (P < 0.001). First 2-year event rates did not differ significantly between procedures. Seven patients died; documented treatment nonadherence was present in all.Conclusions LCSD/BCSD was associated with a substantial reduction in arrhythmic burden, but observational treatment allocation and center-specific management preclude conclusions regarding comparative effectiveness. Sustained treatment adherence remains essential.

AI.tldr: 儿童CPVT患者中，交感神经去支配术（LCSD/BCSD）使心律失常事件率从3.20次/年降至0.00次/年，但死亡患者均存在治疗不依从。
AI.motivation: 儿童CPVT是罕见遗传性心律失常，危及生命的室性心律失常风险高，现有治疗结局证据有限，尤其是LCSD和BCSD的当代疗效需进一步明确。
AI.method: 回顾性多中心研究，纳入土耳其3个三级中心2012-2025年的92例儿童CPVT患者。心律失常事件包括复苏成功的心脏骤停、心源性猝死、ICD适当放电、心律失常性晕厥和室性心动过速。对具有充分术前观察期的患者比较手术前后事件率。
AI.result: 症状发作中位年龄9.25岁，诊断中位年龄11.6岁。87例基因检测患者中74例（85.1%）携带致病/可能致病变异，RYR2和CASQ2变异分别占47.1%和27.6%。50例接受交感神经去支配术（LCSD 25例，BCSD 25例）。配对队列（n=35）中，心律失常事件率从术前3.20次/年（IQR 1.74-8.76）降至术后2年内0.00次/年（IQR 0.00-1.35），P<0.001。两种手术术后2年事件率无显著差异。7例死亡，均有记录的治疗不依从。
AI.conclusion: LCSD/BCSD与心律失常负荷显著降低相关，但观察性治疗分配和中心特异性管理限制比较有效性结论。持续治疗依从性至关重要。

summary_zh:
背景：儿茶酚胺敏感性多形性室性心动过速（CPVT）是一种罕见的遗传性心律失常，儿童期发生危及生命的室性心律失常的风险高。

目的：本研究旨在描述儿童CPVT的特征，并评估当代治疗结局，包括左侧心脏交感神经去神经术（LCSD）和双侧心脏交感神经去神经术（BCSD）。

方法：这项回顾性多中心研究纳入了2012年至2025年间土耳其3个三级中心的92例儿童CPVT患者。心律失常事件包括心脏骤停复苏成功、心源性猝死、植入式心律转复除颤器适当放电、心律失常性晕厥和室性心动过速。在术前观察期充分的患者中，比较了术前和术后配对的事件发生率。

结果：症状发作的中位年龄为9.25岁（IQR：5.88-12.0），诊断的中位年龄为11.6岁（IQR：8.64-14.41）。在87例接受基因检测的患者中，74例（85.1%）携带致病性或可能致病性变异；分别有41例（47.1%）和24例（27.6%）鉴定出ryanodine受体2和calsequestrin 2变异。50例患者接受了交感神经去神经术（LCSD，n=25；BCSD，n=25）。在配对队列（n=35）中，中位心律失常事件发生率从LCSD/BCSD前的3.20次/年（IQR：1.74-8.76）降至术后前2年的0.00次/年（IQR：0.00-1.35）（P<0.001）。两种手术的术后前2年事件发生率无显著差异。7例患者死亡；所有患者均有记录到的治疗不依从。

结论：LCSD/BCSD与心律失常负荷的显著降低相关，但观察性治疗分配和中心特异性管理妨碍了关于比较有效性的结论。持续的治疗依从性仍然至关重要。

title: Mapping publication trends in oral anticoagulation in atrial fibrillation: A bibliometric and thematic analysis of 11,039 publications (2006-2025).
summary:
OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to systematically map the intellectual evolution, thematic development, and collaborative patterns of oral anticoagulation research in atrial fibrillation (AF) from 2006 to 2025.

METHODS: This bibliometric study analyzed 11,039 documents indexed in the Web of Science Core Collection (2006-2025) using the Bibliometrix R package (version 4.x) within the R statistical environment (version 4.3.1) for comprehensive science mapping. The analytical workflow comprised descriptive performance analysis, collaboration network analysis, keyword co-occurrence analysis, strategic thematic mapping, and latent Dirichlet allocation (LDA) topic modeling.

RESULTS: Publication output increased exponentially from 2 articles per year (2006) to a peak of 960 per year (2021), with subsequent stabilization that may reflect consolidation of the field. The United States produced the highest number of publications (3636; 32.9%). The RE-LY trial received the most citations (n=8788). Thematic mapping revealed two main research clusters: Motor themes (141 keywords), representing direct oral anticoagulant agents, stroke prevention, and clinical outcomes; and emerging/declining themes (43 keywords), including venous thromboembolism and pharmacokinetics. LDA topic modeling identified nine distinct research domains encompassing real-world data, safety reporting, and implementation guidelines.

CONCLUSION: The bibliometric patterns observed are consistent with a maturing research field, characterized by a gradual shift from efficacy-focused randomized trials toward real-world effectiveness studies, implementation science, and personalized anticoagulation strategies. Future research may benefit from increased emphasis on long-term adherence, health-economic outcomes, and personalized approaches integrating genetic, clinical, and patient-centered factors.

AI.tldr: 2006-2025年AF口服抗凝研究文献计量分析显示发文量从2篇/年增至2021年峰值960篇/年，研究热点从疗效RCT转向真实世界有效性与个体化抗凝策略。
AI.motivation: AF口服抗凝研究证据快速积累，但缺乏对该领域知识演进、主题发展与协作模式的系统梳理，本研究旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 文献计量学研究，纳入Web of Science核心合集2006-2025年11,039篇文献，使用Bibliometrix R包（4.x版）在R 4.3.1环境中进行描述性表现分析、合作网络分析、关键词共现分析、战略主题映射及LDA主题建模。
AI.result: 年发文量从2006年2篇指数增长至2021年峰值960篇后趋稳；美国发文最多（3636篇，32.9%）；RE-LY试验被引最高（8788次）；主题映射显示两大集群：动力主题（141个关键词，涵盖直接口服抗凝药、卒中预防与临床结局）和新兴/衰退主题（43个关键词，包括静脉血栓栓塞与药代动力学）；LDA识别出9个研究域，涉及真实世界数据、安全性报告与实施指南。
AI.conclusion: 文献计量模式提示该领域趋于成熟，研究重心从疗效RCT转向真实世界有效性研究、实施科学与个体化抗凝策略；未来应关注长期依从性、卫生经济学结局及整合遗传、临床与患者因素的个体化方案。

summary_zh:
目的：本研究旨在系统描绘2006年至2025年间房颤（AF）口服抗凝治疗研究的知识演进、主题发展及合作模式。

方法：本文献计量学研究分析了Web of Science核心合集（2006-2025）中收录的11,039篇文献，使用R统计环境（版本4.3.1）中的Bibliometrix R包（版本4.x）进行全面的科学映射。分析流程包括描述性绩效分析、合作网络分析、关键词共现分析、战略主题映射以及潜在狄利克雷分配（LDA）主题建模。

结果：发文量从2006年的每年2篇呈指数增长至2021年峰值每年960篇，随后趋于稳定，可能反映该领域的整合。美国发文量最高（3636篇；32.9%）。RE-LY试验被引次数最多（n=8788）。主题映射揭示了两大研究集群：驱动主题（141个关键词），代表直接口服抗凝药、卒中预防和临床结局；以及新兴/衰退主题（43个关键词），包括静脉血栓栓塞症和药代动力学。LDA主题建模识别出九个不同的研究领域，涵盖真实世界数据、安全性报告和实施指南。

结论：观察到的文献计量模式与一个成熟的研究领域相一致，其特征是逐渐从以疗效为重点的随机试验转向真实世界有效性研究、实施科学和个体化抗凝策略。未来的研究可能受益于更多关注长期依从性、健康经济学结局以及整合遗传、临床和以患者为中心因素的个体化方法。

title: Pathogenic variants in myoferlin ( MYOF) cause arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy
summary: Abstract Arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy (ACM) is an inherited disease characterized by fibrofatty remodeling and sudden cardiac death linked to desmosomal dysfunction. Yet, 40% of cases remain genetically unexplained, and non-desmosomal mutations offer insight into ACM pathophysiology. Myoferlin (MYOF), a calcium (Ca²⁺)-binding protein in cardiomyocytes, is linked to cardiomyopathy, but its mechanism remains unknown. Whole-exome sequencing identified a heterozygous MYOF missense variant (p.G1654S) in an ACM family; we subsequently found three unrelated p.G1654S cases. We hypothesized that MYOF deficiency promotes Ca²⁺ handling deficits and arrhythmogenesis in ACM. In patient iPSC-derived cardiomyocytes, MYOF p.G1654S protein dimerized with wild-type protein and underwent accelerated lysosomal degradation, showed disrupted Ca²⁺ handling, and displayed increased arrhythmia burden – all rescued by genomic correction. MYOF interacted with CaV1.2, and verapamil pharmacologically rescued arrhythmias. Heterozygous Myof knockout mice showed systolic dysfunction and fibrosis. These findings establish MYOF as a causative ACM gene and therapeutic target that mediates arrhythmogenesis by disrupting MYOF-CaV1.2. One Sentence Summary MYOF deficiency disrupts MYOF-CaV1.2 interaction and calcium handling, causing arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy.

AI.tldr: MYOF p.G1654S变异通过加速蛋白降解破坏MYOF-CaV1.2相互作用和钙处理，导致致心律失常性心肌病，维拉帕米可药理学挽救。
AI.motivation: 致心律失常性心肌病（ACM）是一种遗传性疾病，以纤维脂肪重塑和心源性猝死为特征，与桥粒功能障碍相关。然而，40%的病例遗传病因不明，非桥粒突变有助于理解ACM病理生理。Myoferlin（MYOF）是心肌细胞中的钙结合蛋白，与心肌病相关，但机制未知。
AI.method: 研究类型：遗传学与功能研究。对象：一个ACM家系及三个无关的p.G1654S病例；患者iPSC来源心肌细胞；杂合Myof敲除小鼠。干预/暴露：全外显子测序鉴定MYOF错义变异（p.G1654S）；基因组校正；维拉帕米处理。终点：钙处理、心律失常负荷、收缩功能、纤维化。统计方法：摘要未报告。
AI.result: 在患者iPSC来源心肌细胞中，MYOF p.G1654S蛋白与野生型蛋白二聚化并加速溶酶体降解，显示钙处理紊乱和心律失常负荷增加，基因组校正可挽救所有这些表型。MYOF与CaV1.2相互作用，维拉帕米可药理学挽救心律失常。杂合Myof敲除小鼠显示收缩功能障碍和纤维化。
AI.conclusion: MYOF是 causative ACM基因和治疗靶点，通过破坏MYOF-CaV1.2介导心律失常发生。临床意义：为遗传不明ACM提供新诊断靶点，维拉帕米可能成为治疗选择。局限性：摘要未报告样本量细节和统计值，需进一步验证。

summary_zh: 摘要 致心律失常性心肌病（ACM）是一种遗传性疾病，以纤维脂肪重塑和与桥粒功能障碍相关的猝死为特征。然而，40%的病例在遗传学上仍无法解释，非桥粒突变为了解ACM病理生理学提供了线索。Myoferlin（MYOF）是心肌细胞中的一种钙（Ca²⁺）结合蛋白，与心肌病相关，但其机制尚不清楚。全外显子组测序在一个ACM家系中鉴定出一个杂合MYOF错义变异（p.G1654S）；我们随后发现了三个无关的p.G1654S病例。我们假设MYOF缺陷促进ACM中的Ca²⁺处理缺陷和心律失常发生。在患者iPSC来源的心肌细胞中，MYOF p.G1654S蛋白与野生型蛋白二聚化并经历加速的溶酶体降解，表现出Ca²⁺处理紊乱，并显示心律失常负荷增加——所有这些均通过基因组校正得以挽救。MYOF与CaV1.2相互作用，维拉帕米在药理学上挽救了心律失常。杂合Myof敲除小鼠表现出收缩功能障碍和纤维化。这些发现确立了MYOF作为一个致病性ACM基因和治疗靶点，其通过破坏MYOF-CaV1.2介导心律失常发生。一句话总结 MYOF缺陷破坏MYOF-CaV1.2相互作用和钙处理，导致致心律失常性心肌病。
